examples.en: The doctor ran several blood tests to determine the cause of cholestasis.
examples.zh: 医生进行了几次血液检查，以确定胆汁淤积的原因。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cholestasis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an early stringed instrument like a piano but with more delicate sound

examples.en: She played an intimate baroque melody on the delicate, antique clavichord.
examples.zh: 她在那架精致古老的击弦古钢琴上弹奏了一曲典雅的巴洛克旋律。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 clavichord 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （煤矿井里的）采煤工作面, 采掘面
lemmas.def_en: the part of a coal seam that is being cut

examples.en: Miners worked tirelessly at the dark coalface under extremely hazardous conditions.
examples.zh: 矿工们在极其危险的环境下，在黑暗的采煤工作面不知疲倦地工作。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coalface 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a birdhouse for pigeons

examples.en: The family placed their grandmother's memorial urn into the marble columbarium.
examples.zh: 这家人将祖母的骨灰盒安放在大理石骨灰安置所中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 columbarium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 领圣餐的人, 传达信息者, 通知者
lemmas.def_en: a person entitled to receive Communion

examples.en: Every devout communicant approached the altar quietly to receive the holy sacrament.
examples.zh: 每位虔诚的领圣餐者都静静走向祭坛领受圣餐。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 communicant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 皮革的, 皮质的, 坚韧的
lemmas.def_en: resembling or made to resemble leather; tough but pliable

examples.en: The tropical plant has thick, coriaceous leaves that retain moisture effectively.
examples.zh: 这种热带植物拥有厚实且坚韧如皮革的叶片，能有效保持水分。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coriaceous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the deep vascular inner layer of the skin

examples.en: Nerve endings and small blood vessels are located deep within the corium.
examples.zh: 神经末梢和微血管位于真皮深处。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 corium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a loose dressing gown for women

examples.en: She wrapped her warm housecoat around herself before sipping morning tea.
examples.zh: 她在喝早茶前把温暖的家常服裹在身上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 housecoat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a narrow ridge of hills

examples.en: The narrow hiking trail followed the sharp ridge of the rocky hogback.
examples.zh: 狭窄的徒步小径沿着岩石鬃丘陡峭的脊线延伸。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hogback 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无疑的, 确实的, 明显的
lemmas.def_en: too obvious to be doubted

examples.en: Her extraordinary musical talent was indubitable after that breathtaking concert performance.
examples.zh: 在那场令人惊叹的音乐会演出后，她非凡的音乐才华毋庸置疑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 indubitable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: excellent or splendid

examples.en: Grandfather wore a spiffing new tweed suit to the family garden party.
examples.zh: 祖父穿着一套漂亮的全新粗花呢西装参加了家庭游园会。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spiffing 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an uncontrollable desire to set fire to things

examples.en: The serial arsonist was diagnosed with severe pyromania during the trial.
examples.zh: 那名连环纵火犯在审判期间被诊断出患有严重的放火狂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pyromania 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a curve or surface whose equation (in Cartesian coordinates) is of the second degree

examples.en: The advanced mathematics lecture focused on classifying various types of quadric surfaces.
examples.zh: 那堂高等数学课重点讲解了各类二次曲面的分类。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 quadric 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a rapid series of short loud sounds (as might be heard with a stethoscope in some types of respiratory disorders)

examples.en: The physician listened carefully for any subtle rale in the patient's lungs.
examples.zh: 医生仔细听诊患者肺部是否有任何微弱的罗音。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rale 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a cheese dish made with egg and bread crumbs that is baked and served in individual fireproof dishes

examples.en: The chef baked individual portions of rich chocolate soufflé in each ramekin.
examples.zh: 厨师在每个小烤盅里单独烤制了浓郁的巧克力蛋奶酥。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ramekin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: measuring instrument for measuring the refractive index of a substance

examples.en: The winemaker used a handheld refractometer to measure the grape juice's sugar.
examples.zh: 酿酒师使用便携式折射计测量葡萄汁的含糖量。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 refractometer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 萨伐仑松饼(一种圈状重油发面饼,在酒味糖浆中浸渍过)
lemmas.def_en: a sponge cake baked in a ring mold

examples.en: We enjoyed a classic rum savarin garnished with fresh whipped cream.
examples.zh: 我们享用了一款配有新鲜鲜奶油的经典朗姆萨伐仑蛋糕。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 savarin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: minute blackish gregarious flies destructive to mushrooms and seedlings

examples.en: Larvae of the sciara fly can cause significant damage to potted plants.
examples.zh: 蕈蚊的幼虫会对盆栽植物造成严重损害。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sciara 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: visual examination (with a sigmoidoscope) of the lower third of the colon in a search for polyps

examples.en: The doctor recommended a routine sigmoidoscopy to inspect the lower intestinal tract.
examples.zh: 医生建议进行常规乙状结肠镜检查以查看下消化道。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sigmoidoscopy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who walks about in their sleep

examples.en: The sleeping somnambulist opened the bedroom door without ever waking up once.
examples.zh: 那个梦游者打开了卧室的门，中途一次也没有醒来。

lemmas.def_en: walking by a person who is asleep

examples.en: His childhood somnambulism caused him to wander the house while fast asleep.
examples.zh: 他童年时期的梦游症使他常在熟睡中在房子里走动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 somnambulist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 多余, 过多, 剩余
lemmas.def_en: a quantity that is more than what is appropriate

examples.en: The autumn harvest brought a superabundance of fresh apples to local markets.
examples.zh: 秋季的大丰收为当地市场带来了过剩的新鲜苹果。

lemmas.def_en: most excessively abundant

examples.en: Heavy autumn rains resulted in a superabundant harvest of wild mushrooms this year.
examples.zh: 秋季连绵的大雨促成了今年野生蘑菇的极其丰收。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 superabundance 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of an electrical system that uses or generates two or more alternating voltages of the same frequency but differing in phase angle

examples.en: The factory relies on a powerful polyphase electrical system to run heavy machinery.
examples.zh: 该工厂依靠强大的多相电力系统来运行重型机械。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 polyphase 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: large hardy shrub with showy and strongly fragrant creamy-white flowers in short terminal racemes

examples.en: A fragrant sweet syringa bloomed beside the wooden fence, attracting many bees.
examples.zh: 木栅栏旁盛开着芬芳的山梅花，吸引了许多蜜蜂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 syringa 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a metallic element of the rare earth group; used in lasers; occurs in apatite and monazite and xenotime and ytterbite

examples.en: Terbium is a rare earth element commonly used in green phosphors for displays.
examples.zh: 铽是一种稀土元素，常用于显示器的绿色荧光粉中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 terbium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: male hawk especially male peregrine or gyrfalcon

examples.en: The falconer released the agile tercel to chase the swift pheasant across the field.
examples.zh: 猎鹰人放飞了那只敏捷的雄鹰，去田野上追赶敏捷的野鸡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tercel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a channel in which a tidal current runs

examples.en: The cargo boat struggled to steer against the fierce current of the river tideway.
examples.zh: 货船在河流强潮急流的冲击下艰难地把舵前行。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tideway 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 悲剧演员, 悲剧作家
lemmas.def_en: a writer (especially a playwright) who writes tragedies

examples.en: The veteran tragedian captivated the silent audience with a haunting deathbed monologue.
examples.zh: 这位资深悲剧演员以一段动人的临终独白迷住了全场寂静的观众。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tragedian 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 学院一年级学生, 学院二年级学生, 中学一年级学生, 中学二年级学生
lemmas.def_en: an undergraduate who is not yet a senior

examples.en: Every underclassman must complete mandatory core courses before choosing their specific academic major.
examples.zh: 每位低年级学生在选择具体专业之前都必须完成必修的核心课程。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 underclassman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having a lower population density than normal or desirable

examples.en: The vast northern region remains underpopulated due to its harsh, freezing climate.
examples.zh: 由于严寒恶劣的气候，广阔的北部地区依然人口稀少。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 underpopulated 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 后翅, 后翅色彩瑰丽的蛾
lemmas.def_en: moth having dull forewings and brightly colored hind wings

examples.en: The moth flashed its vibrant orange underwing to scare away potential predators.
examples.zh: 这只飞蛾露出鲜艳的橙色后翅，以吓跑潜在的捕食者。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 underwing 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (of the testis) remaining in the abdomen instead of descending into the scrotum

examples.en: The pediatric surgeon recommended a minor operation to correct the infant's undescended testicle.
examples.zh: 小儿外科医生建议通过微创手术来矫正婴儿的隐睾。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 undescended 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: softwood used to make paper

examples.en: Trucks hauled loads of freshly cut pulpwood toward the nearby paper manufacturing mill.
examples.zh: 卡车装载着刚砍伐的造纸原木，运往附近的造纸厂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pulpwood 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 衬衫领子, (作装饰用的)领圈
lemmas.def_en: a band around the collar of a garment

examples.en: The tailor stitched a soft silk neckband inside the collar for extra comfort.
examples.zh: 裁缝在领子内侧缝制了一条柔软的真丝领圈，以增加舒适度。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 neckband 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: equal in duration or interval

examples.en: The grandfather clock relies on the isochronous swings of a weighted brass pendulum.
examples.zh: 落地钟依靠加重黄铜钟摆的等时摆动来精确走时。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 isochronous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an electron tube used to generate or amplify electromagnetic radiation in the microwave region by velocity modulation

examples.en: Engineers replaced the damaged klystron to restore the radar transmitter to full power.
examples.zh: 工程师更换了损坏的调速管，使雷达发射机恢复了全部功率。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 klystron 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a monster able to change appearance from human to wolf and back again

examples.en: Folklore tells of a tormented lycanthrope who roams the misty forest during full moons.
examples.zh: 民间传说中有一个饱受折磨的狼人，在满月时漫游在迷雾弥漫的森林中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lycanthrope 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: hormone that is one of the steroids of the adrenal cortex that influences the metabolism of sodium and potassium

examples.en: Aldosterone is a vital mineralocorticoid that regulates water balance and sodium retention.
examples.zh: 醛固酮是一种重要的盐皮质激素，负责调节水分平衡和钠潴留。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mineralocorticoid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small Asian deer with small antlers and a cry like a bark

examples.en: A startled muntjac darted through the thick bushes before vanishing into deep woods.
examples.zh: 一只受惊的麂子穿过灌木丛，随即消失在密林深处。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 muntjac 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an informer or spy working for the police

examples.en: The smugglers suspected that an informant or police nark had betrayed their secret hideout.
examples.zh: 走私犯怀疑有内奸或警方密探出卖了他们的秘密藏身处。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nark 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small subgenus of ornamental tropical shrubs or trees; not recognized in some classifications

examples.en: The royal poinciana lined the coastal boulevard, ablaze with brilliant scarlet blossoms.
examples.zh: 凤凰木整齐地排列在海滨林荫道旁，绽放出灿烂的鲜红色花朵。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 poinciana 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: nervous breakdown (not in technical use)

examples.en: Chronic stress and sleep deprivation led to severe neurasthenia and constant emotional fatigue.
examples.zh: 长期压力和睡眠不足导致了严重的神经衰弱和持续的情绪倦怠。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 neurasthenia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 发出嘈杂声的人, 噪音发生器
lemmas.def_en: a device (such as a clapper or bell or horn) used to make a loud noise at a celebration

examples.en: Each guest was given a colorful paper noisemaker to celebrate the New Year.
examples.zh: 每位客人都得到了一个彩色的纸质发声器，用来庆祝新年。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 noisemaker 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: inflammation of a bone as a consequence of infection or trauma or degeneration

examples.en: The patient received intravenous antibiotics to cure bacterial osteitis in his jaw.
examples.zh: 该患者接受了静脉输注抗生素，以治疗下颌的细菌性骨炎。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 osteitis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 田园曲, 牧歌式歌剧
lemmas.def_en: a musical composition that evokes rural life

examples.en: The orchestra performed a serene pastorale that evoked images of peaceful rural landscapes.
examples.zh: 管弦乐队演奏了一曲宁静的田园曲，让人联想到宁静的乡村风光。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pastorale 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the male head of family or tribe

examples.en: As the traditional paterfamilias, he made all the major financial decisions for the household.
examples.zh: 作为传统的一家之主，他为家庭做出所有重大的财务决定。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 paterfamilias 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a slip of paper included with your pay that records how much money you have earned and how much tax or insurance etc. has been taken out

examples.en: She carefully checked her monthly payslip to make sure the overtime hours were correct.
examples.zh: 她仔细核对了月度工资单，以确保加班时长准确无误。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 payslip 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 水闸门, 水道, 水渠
lemmas.def_en: regulator consisting of a valve or gate that controls the rate of water flow through a sluice

examples.en: Engineers opened the massive penstock to direct rushing water toward the spinning turbines.
examples.zh: 工程师们打开了巨大的水闸门，引导湍急的水流冲向旋转的涡轮机。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 penstock 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the ripened and variously modified walls of a plant ovary

examples.en: The tough pericarp protects the delicate seed from severe weather and hungry pests.
examples.zh: 坚韧的果皮保护着脆弱的种子免受恶劣天气和饥饿害虫的侵害。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pericarp 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 有雌蕊的, 只有雌蕊的
lemmas.def_en: bearing or consisting of carpels

examples.en: Botanists identified several pistillate flowers that produce fruit only after receiving foreign pollen.
examples.zh: 植物学家辨认出几种雌花，它们只有在接受外来花粉后才会结果。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pistillate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 护胸, 胸铠, 胸甲, 胸饰
lemmas.def_en: the ornamental front of a woman's bodice or shirt

examples.en: The fencing instructor adjusted his padded plastron before initiating the advanced sword drills.
examples.zh: 击剑教练在开始高阶剑术训练前调整了他的软垫护胸。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 plastron 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: short and plump

examples.en: The child gripped the colorful crayon tightly with his soft, podgy little fingers.
examples.zh: 那个孩子用他肉乎乎的小手紧紧握着那支彩色的蜡笔。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 podgy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (19th century) a man's high tasseled boot

examples.en: The oppressive regime enforced its cruel laws beneath the heavy tread of the jackboot.
examples.zh: 这个压迫性的政权在军靴的重踏之下强行推行其残酷的法令。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jackboot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 可替换的, 可代替的
lemmas.def_en: (of words) interchangeable in a given context without changing the import of the expression

examples.en: These electronic components are completely substitutable, so you can safely use either one.
examples.zh: 这些电子元件完全可以互换，因此你可以放心使用其中任何一个。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 可代换性, 可置换性
lemmas.def_en: exchangeability by virtue of being replaceable

family_guide.root_logic: 以 substitutable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To unlock and open a door or gate by removing its wooden or metal bar.

examples.en: The cautious night watchman refused to unbar the heavy wooden gates after midnight.
examples.zh: 谨慎的守夜人拒绝在半夜后打开沉重的木门。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unbar 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 掘出, 发掘, 使显露
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (formal) To dig a dead body or buried object out of the ground, or uncover forgotten facts.

examples.en: Archaeologists received official permission to disinter the ancient royal coffin for scientific analysis.
examples.zh: 考古学家获得了官方许可，得以发掘古代皇家棺木进行科学分析。

lemmas.def_en: the act of digging something out of the ground (especially a corpse) where it has been buried

family_guide.root_logic: 以 disinter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a larva of a woodborer

examples.en: A thorough inspection revealed that aggressive woodworm had severely weakened the antique cabinet.
examples.zh: 彻底的检查显示，木蛀虫的严重侵害已使这个古董柜变得脆弱不堪。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 woodworm 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 翠绿, 新绿, 碧绿, 精力旺盛, 新鲜
lemmas.def_en: green foliage

examples.en: Heavy spring rains soon restored the lush verdure across the dry mountain valleys.
examples.zh: 春季的连绵大雨很快使干燥的山谷重新恢复了生机盎然的青翠。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 verdure 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a fast sailboat with 3 parallel hulls

examples.en: The sleek modern trimaran glided effortlessly across the bay during the weekend regatta.
examples.zh: 在周末的帆船赛中，那艘流畅的现代三体船在海湾上轻快地滑行。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 trimaran 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a deceitful and unreliable scoundrel

examples.en: The furious merchant shouted that the cheating varlet had stolen half his profits.
examples.zh: 愤怒的商人叫嚷着，说那个欺诈的恶棍偷走了他一半的利润。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 varlet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不可改变地, 坚定不移地
lemmas.def_en: in an unalterable and unchangeable manner

examples.en: The retired general remained unalterably opposed to any military intervention in the region.
examples.zh: 这位退役将军仍然坚定不移地反对在该地区进行任何军事干预。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unalterably 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a tuberous Mexican herb having grasslike leaves and cultivated for its spikes of highly fragrant lily-like waxy white flowers

examples.en: The sweet, heady fragrance of fresh tuberose drifted through the crowded summer garden.
examples.zh: 新鲜晚香玉浓郁甜美的香气在熙熙攘攘的夏日花园中弥漫开来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tuberose 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: ship for transporting troops

examples.en: Thousands of nervous young soldiers boarded the crowded troopship destined for the front.
examples.zh: 数千名忐忑不安的年轻士兵登上了驶往前线、拥挤不堪的运兵船。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 troopship 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: one of two shafts extending from the body of a cart or carriage on either side of the animal that pulls it

examples.en: The strong draft horse was securely harnessed between the wooden thills of the cart.
examples.zh: 那匹强壮的挽马被牢固地套在大车的两根木质车辕之间。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 thill 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of numerous compressed deep-bodied tropical fishes with sandpapery skin and erectile spines in the first dorsal fin

examples.en: A colorful triggerfish defended its coral nest aggressively against every curious diver nearby.
examples.zh: 一条色彩斑斓的扳机鱼凶猛地守护着它的珊瑚巢穴，驱赶周围好奇的潜水员。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 triggerfish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 毕生的事业, 一生中最重要的工作
lemmas.def_en: the principal work of your career

examples.en: Publishing the comprehensive medical encyclopedia was the ultimate lifework of the renowned scholar.
examples.zh: 出版这部综合性医学百科全书是这位著名学者一生的心血结晶。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lifework 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: tropical Asian starlings

examples.en: A chatty mynah perched on the windowsill and cleverly repeated every word we said.
examples.zh: 一只健谈的八哥栖息在窗台上，灵巧地重复着我们说的每一个字。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mynah 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 能产生多种效果(或结果)的
lemmas.def_en: able to many things

examples.en: Scientists study multipotent stem cells because they can easily develop into several tissue types.
examples.zh: 科学家研究多能干细胞，因为它们能轻易分化为数种不同的组织类型。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 multipotent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an island to the northwest of Wales

examples.en: The agile mona monkey leaped effortlessly through the dense canopy of the tropical forest.
examples.zh: 那只敏捷的白腹长尾猴在热带森林茂密的树冠间轻松穿梭跳跃。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 monas 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] ('militate against') (formal) When facts or conditions militate against something, they make it much harder to happen or succeed.

examples.en: Poor weather and difficult terrain combined to militate against the success of the rescue.
examples.zh: 恶劣的天气和复杂的地形共同对救援行动的成功产生了不利影响。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 militate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an asset of special worth or utility

examples.en: After trying several different careers, she finally found her true metier in investigative journalism.
examples.zh: 尝试了几个不同的职业后，她终于在调查新闻中找到了真正适合自己的工作。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 metier 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a unit of weight used in Asia; has different values in different countries

examples.en: The merchant weighed out a maund of grain to sell at the local market.
examples.zh: 商人在当地市场上称了一莫恩德的粮食准备出售。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 maund 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 有机磷化合物的研究
lemmas.def_en: being seven more than fifty

examples.en: The historian referenced chapter LVII to explain the political shifts of that turbulent era.
examples.zh: 历史学家引用了第57章来解释那个动荡时代的政治转变。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lvii 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a hard protective sheath (as secreted by certain protoctists, for example)

examples.en: The Roman legionary polished his lorica carefully before marching into the fierce battle.
examples.zh: 这位罗马军团士兵在开赴激烈战斗前仔细擦亮了他的胸甲。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lorica 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (of time) constituting the full extent or duration

examples.en: The children spent the livelong day playing hide-and-seek in the sunlit orchard.
examples.zh: 孩子们一整天都在阳光明媚的果园里玩捉迷藏。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 livelong 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 有节的, 多节的, 有圆头的
lemmas.def_en: used of old persons or old trees; covered with knobs or knots

examples.en: The old traveler leaned heavily on a knobbed wooden stick during his long journey.
examples.zh: 老旅行者在漫长的旅途中重重地倚着一根多节的木杖。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 knobbed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 农夫, 百姓, 饲养专家
lemmas.def_en: a person who operates a farm

examples.en: The diligent husbandman inspected his crops early every morning to ensure a bountiful harvest.
examples.zh: 勤劳的农夫每天清晨都巡视庄稼，以确保丰收。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 husbandman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: large green long-horned grasshopper of North America; males produce shrill sounds by rubbing together special organs on the forewings

examples.en: A green katydid rested silently on the broad oak leaf in the warm garden.
examples.zh: 一只绿色的美洲大螽斯静静地停在温暖花园中宽大的橡树叶上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 katydid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (chiefly British) When a vehicle, engine, or machine judders, it shakes and vibrates violently and roughly.

examples.en: The old car began to judder violently as it climbed the steep, rocky hill.
examples.zh: 这辆旧车在爬上陡峭多石的山坡时开始剧烈颤抖。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 judder 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: widely cultivated ornamental plant native to southern Europe but naturalized elsewhere having fragrant yellow or white clustered flowers

examples.en: She planted bright yellow jonquils along the stone path to welcome the early spring.
examples.zh: 她在石路旁种下了亮黄色的长寿花，以迎接早春的到来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jonquil 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 贫弱的, 不毛的, 无味干燥的, 不成熟的
lemmas.def_en: lacking in nutritive value

examples.en: Critics quickly dismissed his latest philosophical essay as jejune and lacking in original thought.
examples.zh: 批评家们很快将他最新的哲学论文斥为枯燥乏味且缺乏原创思想。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jejune 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the situation of being or dying without a legally valid will

examples.en: His sudden death resulted in intestacy, leaving his vast estate divided among several distant relatives.
examples.zh: 他的突然离世导致未留遗嘱，巨大的遗产被分给了几个远房亲戚。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 intestacy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无好奇心的, 不关心的, 平凡无趣的
lemmas.def_en: showing absence of intellectual inquisitiveness or natural curiosity

examples.en: He remained entirely incurious about the strange noises coming from the deserted attic upstairs.
examples.zh: 他对楼上废弃阁楼里传来的奇怪声音完全不感兴趣。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 incurious 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: massive herbivorous bipedal dinosaur with a long heavy tail; common in Europe and northern Africa; early Cretaceous period

examples.en: The natural history museum unveiled a complete fossil skeleton of a massive prehistoric iguanodon.
examples.zh: 自然历史博物馆展出了一具完整的史前大型禽龙化石骨架。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 iguanodon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: in a cold and icy manner

examples.en: She stared icily at the intruder and demanded that he leave her house immediately.
examples.zh: 她冷冰冰地盯着闯入者，要求他立刻离开她的房子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 icily 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 吵闹的, 喧嚣的, 骚乱的, 不守秩序的
lemmas.def_en: noisily and stubbornly defiant

examples.en: The security guards struggled to calm down the obstreperous crowd gathered outside the stadium.
examples.zh: 保安人员努力安抚聚集在体育场外喧闹不服管教的人群。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 obstreperous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [植]墨西哥刺木,马鞭,蔓仙人掌
lemmas.def_en: desert shrub of southwestern United States and Mexico having slender naked spiny branches that after the rainy season put forth foliage and clusters of red flowers

examples.en: The dry desert hillside was dotted with tall ocotillo blooming with brilliant red flowers.
examples.zh: 干燥的沙漠山坡上点缀着盛开鲜红花朵的高大墨西哥刺木。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ocotillo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a dungeon with the only entrance or exit being a trap door in the ceiling

examples.en: The medieval castle featured a dark oubliette where forgotten prisoners were kept in chains.
examples.zh: 这座中世纪城堡设有一个黑暗的地下密牢，被遗忘的囚犯被锁在里面。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 oubliette 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 笨手笨脚的运动员, 笨拙的拳击手
lemmas.def_en: a second-rate prize fighter

examples.en: The seasoned champion easily knocked out the clumsy palooka in the second short round.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的冠军在短短第二回合就轻松击倒了那个笨拙的拳手。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 palooka 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a kind of food poisoning caused by eating foods contaminated with Salmonella typhimurium

examples.en: Eating undercooked poultry poses a high risk of contracting dangerous bacterial salmonellosis.
examples.zh: 食用未煮熟的家禽肉有感染危险的细菌性沙门氏菌病的高风险。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 salmonellosis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a light medieval helmet with a slit for vision

examples.en: The medieval knight adjusted his steel salade before charging toward the enemy lines.
examples.zh: 这位中世纪骑士在冲向敌阵之前调整了他的钢盔。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 salade 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a partly sheltered anchorage

examples.en: Several merchant ships anchored safely in the sheltered roadstead during the violent winter storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨期间，数艘商船安全地停泊在有遮蔽的锚地里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 roadstead 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 给...安排新房子, 给...安排好房屋
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (chiefly British) To provide new homes for people whose houses were destroyed or demolished.

examples.en: The local council promised to rehouse all the families displaced by the sudden flood.
examples.zh: 地方委员会承诺为所有因突发洪水而流离失所的家庭重新安排住所。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rehouse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: expandable metal or wooden wedge used by printers to lock up a form within a chase

examples.en: The stonemason carefully fitted a decorative quoin into the corner of the brick building.
examples.zh: 石匠仔细地将一块装饰性墙角石安装到了砖楼的外角上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 quoin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: strong cider (as made in western England)

examples.en: We tasted some strong traditional scrumpy while visiting a farm in Devon.
examples.zh: 我们在德文郡参观农场时品尝了一些强劲的传统苹果烈酒。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scrumpy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: food for domestic livestock

examples.en: The farmer stored enough provender in the barn to feed his cattle all winter.
examples.zh: 农夫在谷仓里储存了足够的草料，以供牲口过冬。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 provender 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 左的, 使用左手的, 左旋的
lemmas.def_en: of or on the left

examples.en: The biologist noted the rare sinistral shell coiling to the left instead of right.
examples.zh: 生物学家注意到这个罕见的左旋贝壳是向左而非向右螺旋的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sinistral 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: capable of fertilizing female organs

examples.en: The staminate flowers produce abundant pollen to fertilize nearby female blossoms.
examples.zh: 这些雄蕊花产生大量的花粉来为附近的雌花授粉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 staminate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 捕食其他动物的, 食肉的
lemmas.def_en: hunting and killing other animals for food

examples.en: Dragonflies are predaceous insects that hunt mosquitoes and small flies in midair.
examples.zh: 蜻蜓是捕食性昆虫，会在半空中猎杀蚊子和小飞虫。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 predaceous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 后工业化的, 工业化后的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to a society or economy marked by a lessened importance of manufacturing and an increase of services, information, and research

examples.en: The old factory district was transformed into a trendy postindustrial arts center.
examples.zh: 老工业区被改造成了一个时髦的后工业艺术中心。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 postindustrial 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 炼钢工; 钢铁制造商
lemmas.def_en: a worker engaged in making steel

examples.en: The major steelmaker announced plans to invest heavily in green hydrogen technology.
examples.zh: 这家大型钢铁制造商宣布了大力投资绿氢技术的计划。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 steelmaker 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 绒球, 丝球, 绒球菊花
lemmas.def_en: decoration consisting of a ball of tufted wool or silk; usually worn on a hat

examples.en: She knitted a warm winter beanie topped with a fluffy red pompon.
examples.zh: 她织了一顶保暖的冬日无檐便帽，顶上配着一个蓬松的红绒球。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pompon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a salt or ester of polyphosphoric acid

examples.en: The food manufacturer added polyphosphate to help retain moisture in processed meats.
examples.zh: 食品制造商添加了多磷酸盐，以帮助加工肉类保持水分。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 polyphosphate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 愉快地; 舒适地; 快乐地; 欢愉地
lemmas.def_en: in a very pleasurable manner

examples.en: They spent the sunny afternoon pleasurably lounging beside the hotel swimming pool.
examples.zh: 他们惬意地躺在酒店泳池旁，度过了阳光明媚的下午。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pleasurably 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small informal nursery group meeting for half-day sessions

examples.en: The toddler attends playschool three mornings a week to make new friends.
examples.zh: 这个蹒跚学步的孩子每周有三个上午去幼儿游戏组结识新朋友。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 playschool 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 叉口, 裙叉, 女裙口袋
lemmas.def_en: a piece of cloth sewn under an opening

examples.en: She ironed the shirt carefully, making sure the button placket stayed flat.
examples.zh: 她仔细地熨烫衬衫，确保纽扣门襟平整。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 placket 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 辛辣, 辣味, 尖刻, 激励, 可爱
lemmas.def_en: a tart spicy quality

examples.en: A dash of fresh lime juice gave the rich sauce a delightful piquancy.
examples.zh: 少许新鲜青柠汁为浓郁的酱汁增添了令人愉悦的辛香风味。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 piquancy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small olive-colored woodland flycatchers of eastern North America

examples.en: We heard the plaintive whistle of an eastern pewee high in the treetops.
examples.zh: 我们听到高高树梢上传来东部美洲小燕凄婉的鸣叫声。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pewee 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [生](细胞融合后形成的)杂种细胞,杂种瘤
lemmas.def_en: a hybrid cell resulting from the fusion of a lymphocyte and a tumor cell; used to culture a specific monoclonal antibody

examples.en: Scientists fused the cells to generate a hybridoma capable of producing specific antibodies.
examples.zh: 科学家融合了这些细胞，以生成能够产生特异性抗体的杂交瘤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hybridoma 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: northern African mongoose; in ancient times thought to devour crocodile eggs

examples.en: The ancient Egyptians revered the ichneumon for its ability to hunt dangerous snakes.
examples.zh: 古埃及人尊崇埃及獴，因为它们拥有捕猎毒蛇的能力。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ichneumon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: winged fly parasitic on horses

examples.en: A painful horsefly bite interrupted our quiet walk near the swampy riverbank.
examples.zh: 一次剧痛的马蝇叮咬打断了我们在沼泽河岸旁的静谧散步。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 horsefly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: inflammation of the gall bladder

examples.en: The patient was hospitalized with acute cholecystitis after suffering severe abdominal pain.
examples.zh: 该患者因严重的腹痛伴随急性胆囊炎而住院。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cholecystitis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 网眼状的, 网状骨质的, 海绵状的, 多孔的
lemmas.def_en: having an open or latticed or porous structure

examples.en: Osteoporosis significantly weakens the porous cancellous bone found inside the vertebrae.
examples.zh: 骨质疏松症会显著削弱脊椎内部多孔的海绵状骨质。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cancellous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: crust or layer of hard subsoil encrusted with calcium-carbonate occurring in arid or semiarid regions

examples.en: The miners extracted valuable nitrates from the dense caliche deposits in the desert.
examples.zh: 矿工们从沙漠中致密的生硝矿床中提取出了宝贵的硝酸盐。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 caliche 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a high-speed motorcycle race on a public road

examples.en: Engineers monitor the fuel burnup carefully to optimize the nuclear reactor's efficiency.
examples.zh: 工程师们仔细监测燃料燃耗，以优化核反应堆的运行效率。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 burnup 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 超级妈妈；妈妈超人；超级嬷嬷
lemmas.def_en: an informal term for a mother who can combine childcare and full-time employment

examples.en: She felt pressured to be a supermom who perfectly balanced career and parenting.
examples.zh: 她感到巨大的压力，非要把自己变成一个完美兼顾事业和育儿的超级妈妈不可。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 supermom 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a denture anchored to teeth on either side of missing teeth

examples.en: The dentist recommended customized bridgework to replace her missing lower molars.
examples.zh: 牙医建议做定制牙桥，以替补她缺失的下磨牙。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bridgework 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having a short broad head with a cephalic index of over 80

examples.en: Brachycephalic dog breeds like pugs often suffer from chronic breathing difficulties.
examples.zh: 像八哥犬这样的短头犬品种经常遭受慢性呼吸困难的困扰。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 brachycephalic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a woman benefactor

examples.en: The museum named the new gallery after its most generous benefactress.
examples.zh: 博物馆以其最慷慨的女施主之名为新展厅命名。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 benefactress 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (Roman Catholic Church) a member of a lay sisterhood (one of several founded in the Netherlands in the 12th and 13th centuries); though not taking religious vows the sisters followed an austere life

examples.en: Couples danced a lively beguine across the ballroom under the soft lights.
examples.zh: 情侣们在柔和的灯光下于宴会厅中跳起欢快的比津舞。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 beguine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (linguistics) omission at the beginning of a word as in `coon' for `raccoon' or `till' for `until'

examples.en: Linguists noted that words like 'round' evolved through apheresis from 'around'.
examples.zh: 语言学家指出，诸如“round”等词是由“around”省去词首演变而来的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 apheresis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 反垄断；防止(或消除)垄断
lemmas.def_en: of laws and regulations; designed to protect trade and commerce from unfair business practices

examples.en: Regulators launched an antimonopoly probe into the tech giant's business practices.
examples.zh: 监管机构对这家科技巨头的商业行为展开了反垄断调查。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 antimonopoly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of several amber to coppery fork-tailed warm-water carangid fishes

examples.en: The chef served fresh grilled amberjack with a light lemon butter sauce.
examples.zh: 大厨端上了配有淡柠檬黄油汁的新鲜烤琥珀鱼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 amberjack 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a radioactive element of the actinide series; found in uranium ores

examples.en: Researchers handled the rare sample of actinium with extreme caution in the lab.
examples.zh: 研究人员在实验室里极其小心地处理稀有的锕样本。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 actinium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small dry indehiscent fruit with the seed distinct from the fruit wall

examples.en: Each tiny yellow speck on the strawberry's surface is technically an achene.
examples.zh: 草莓表面上的每一个微小黄色斑点在植物学上都是一颗瘦果。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 achene 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: causing abortion

examples.en: Certain wild herbs were historically avoided due to their dangerous abortifacient properties.
examples.zh: 历史上某些野草因其具有危险的堕胎特性而常被避用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 abortifacient 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 自然发生论, 无生源说
lemmas.def_en: a hypothetical organic phenomenon by which living organisms are created from nonliving matter

examples.en: Scientists study ancient hydrothermal vents to understand the possible origin of abiogenesis.
examples.zh: 科学家研究古老的海底热泉，以探索自然发生论的可能起源。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 abiogenesis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: inflammation of the synovial membrane that lines a synovial joint; results in pain and swelling

examples.en: The athlete rested his swollen knee after being diagnosed with acute synovitis.
examples.zh: 这位运动员在被诊断出患有急性滑膜炎后卧床静养其肿胀的膝盖。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 synovitis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 缓步类动物, 节肢动物
lemmas.def_en: an arthropod of the division Tardigrada

examples.en: Under the microscope, the tardigrade moved slowly across the wet moss sample.
examples.zh: 在显微镜下，那只缓步动物在潮湿的苔藓样本上缓慢爬行。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tardigrade 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 装置, 小机件, 某人, 某物件, 某东西
lemmas.def_en: something unspecified whose name is either forgotten or not known

examples.en: He asked me to hand him the little metal thingamajig on the workbench.
examples.zh: 他让我把工作台上那个小金属物件递给他。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 thingamajig 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse

examples.en: The old town was famous for its timeworn cobblestone streets and ancient walls.
examples.zh: 这座古镇以其陈旧斑驳的鹅卵石街道和古城墙而闻名。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 timeworn 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 细心的, 吝啬的, 谨慎的
lemmas.def_en: characterized by great caution and wariness

examples.en: Investors remain chary of committing funds to projects with unproven track records.
examples.zh: 投资者对于向缺乏成功先例的项目投入资金仍持谨慎态度。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an inn in some eastern countries with a large courtyard that provides accommodation for caravans

examples.en: The ancient caravanserai once provided shelter and water to Silk Road merchants.
examples.zh: 这座古老的商队旅馆曾为丝绸之路上的商人提供食宿与水源。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 caravanserai 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: attire to wear on formal occasions in the evening

examples.en: Guests were requested to dress in elegant formalwear for the charity gala.
examples.zh: 宾客们被要求身着优雅的正装出席这场慈善晚会。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 formalwear 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: congenital condition in which external genitalia and internal sex organs have both male and female characteristics

examples.en: Sequential hermaphroditism is commonly observed among various species of tropical reef fish.
examples.zh: 顺序性雌雄同体现象在多种热带珊瑚礁鱼类中十分常见。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hermaphroditism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a saw used with one hand for cutting wood

examples.en: He grabbed a sharp handsaw from the tool shed to trim the branch.
examples.zh: 他从工具房拿了一把锋利的手锯去修剪树枝。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 handsaw 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a sight used for aiming a gun

examples.en: The marksman carefully aligned the gunsight with the distant practice target.
examples.zh: 神射手仔细地将瞄准器对准远处的训练靶心。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gunsight 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 呼吸/打鼾声音粗大的人
lemmas.def_en: predatory black-and-white toothed whale with large dorsal fin; common in cold seas

examples.en: The tired hiker was breathing like a grampus after climbing the steep ridge.
examples.zh: 疲惫的徒步者在爬上陡峭的山脊后，喘气声粗大如雷。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 grampus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a metric unit of weight equal to one thousandth of a kilogram

examples.en: The gold pendant was surprisingly light, weighing scarcely more than a gramme.
examples.zh: 这个黄金吊坠出奇地轻，重量仅有一克多一点。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gramme 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an instance of boastful talk

examples.en: His constant gasconade about wealth alienated most of his newly made colleagues.
examples.zh: 他对自己财富无休止的吹嘘疏远了大多数新结识的同事。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gasconade 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [鱼]军曹鱼(产于热带海洋,可供食用)
lemmas.def_en: large dark-striped tropical food and game fish related to remoras; found worldwide in coastal to open waters

examples.en: The coastal restaurant offered pan-seared cobia paired with fresh garden vegetables.
examples.zh: 这家海滨餐厅供应香煎军曹鱼配新鲜菜园时蔬。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cobia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person who foretells your personal future

examples.en: The old fortuneteller read my palm and predicted I would travel across the world.
examples.zh: 那位老算命先生看了我的手相，预言我将周游世界。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fortuneteller 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 平截头体, 截头锥体
lemmas.def_en: a truncated cone or pyramid; the part that is left when a cone or pyramid is cut by a plane parallel to the base and the apical part is removed

examples.en: The math teacher asked the students to calculate the total volume of the frustum.
examples.zh: 数学老师要求学生们计算这个平截头体的总体积。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 frustum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: relating to the epiphysis of a bone

examples.en: An X-ray was taken to check if the child had suffered an epiphyseal fracture.
examples.zh: 医生拍了X光片，以检查该儿童是否有骨骺骨折。

lemmas.def_en: the end of a long bone; initially separated from the main bone by a layer of cartilage that eventually ossifies so the parts become fused

examples.en: An X-ray showed a minor fracture near the epiphysis of the boy's thighbone.
examples.zh: X光检查显示该男孩大腿骨骺端附近有一处轻微骨折。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 epiphyseal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: parasitic on the digestive epithelium of vertebrates and higher invertebrates

examples.en: The veterinarian diagnosed the sick poultry with a severe infection caused by Eimeria parasites.
examples.zh: 兽医诊断这些患病的家禽感染了严重的艾美球虫寄生虫病。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 eimeria 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 犬齿, 犬牙, 犬牙饰
lemmas.def_en: perennial woodland spring-flowering plant; widely cultivated

examples.en: The ancient stone arch was decorated with a finely carved medieval dogtooth pattern.
examples.zh: 那座古老的石拱门上装饰着雕刻精美的中世纪犬牙花纹。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dogtooth 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可引出的, 可诱导的, 可推论的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being derived

examples.en: The secondary conclusion is readily derivable from the basic principles established in the text.
examples.zh: 这个次要结论很容易从文中确立的基本原理中推导出来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 derivable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: yearling heifer or bullock

examples.en: The farmer herded the young stirk into the barn before the winter storm arrived.
examples.zh: 在冬季风暴来临之前，农夫把那头小牛赶进了牲口棚。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stirk 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a metric unit of volume equal to one tenth of a liter

examples.en: The chef measured exactly one deciliter of cream for the rich pasta sauce.
examples.zh: 厨师为浓郁的意面酱汁精确量取了一分升奶油。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 deciliter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any species of the genus Corynebacterium

examples.en: Certain harmless strains of Corynebacterium are commonly found living naturally on human skin.
examples.zh: 某些无害的棒状杆菌菌株通常天然存在于人类皮肤表面。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 corynebacterium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the stalk of a corn plant

examples.en: Dry cornstalks rustled in the cool breeze as autumn settled over the quiet farm.
examples.zh: 当秋天降临寂静的农场时，干燥的玉米秆在凉爽的微风中沙沙作响。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cornstalk 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of several breeds of hound developed for hunting raccoons

examples.en: The hunter followed the loud barking of his coonhound through the dark forest.
examples.zh: 猎人穿过黑暗的森林，跟随着他的猎浣熊犬嘹亮的吠叫声。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coonhound 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 连续的嘟嘟吹奏, 休闲旅行
lemmas.def_en: the sound of casual playing on a musical instrument

examples.en: We took a leisurely tootle through the countryside in our vintage convertible on Sunday.
examples.zh: 周日，我们开着复古敞篷车在乡间悠闲地兜风。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tootle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (historical) To equip a warhorse with protective decorative armor (barding).

examples.en: The squire helped barde the warhorse in polished steel plate before the tournament.
examples.zh: 比武开始前，侍从帮助给战马披上了打磨光亮的钢制马铠。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (cooking) To wrap thin slices of fat or bacon over lean meat before roasting.

examples.en: caparison the horses for the festive occasion

family_guide.root_logic: 以 barde 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the ordinal number of one trillion in counting order

examples.en: Modern laboratory lasers can measure events occurring within a trillionth of a second accurately.
examples.zh: 现代实验室激光器可以精确测量一万亿分之一秒内发生的事情。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 trillionth 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: abnormal dryness of the mouth resulting from decreased secretion of saliva

examples.en: Patients taking these medications often complain of xerostomia and persistent throat irritation.
examples.zh: 服用这些药物的患者常常抱怨口干以及持续的咽喉刺激。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 xerostomia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who swindles you by not repaying a debt or wager

examples.en: Nobody in town wanted to gamble with him because he was a known welcher.
examples.zh: 镇上没人愿意和他赌博，因为他是出了名的赖账者。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 welcher 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 得不到食物的, 没东西吃的, 得不到支持的
lemmas.def_en: not fed

examples.en: The unfed kittens cried pitifully outside the door until someone finally brought warm milk.
examples.zh: 没吃东西的小猫在门外可怜地叫着，直到终于有人送来了温牛奶。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unfed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 向性, 取向, 定向
lemmas.def_en: an involuntary orienting response; positive or negative reaction to a stimulus source

examples.en: The bending of seedlings toward window sunlight is a classic example of phototropic tropism.
examples.zh: 幼苗向着窗外阳光弯曲是向光性这种定向反应的典型例子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tropism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (nautical) a rope used in towing

examples.en: The harbor crew secured the heavy towline before the tugboat moved the barge.
examples.zh: 在拖船移动驳船之前，码头工作人员固定好了沉重的拖缆。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 towline 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the track on which trams or streetcars run

examples.en: A newly painted tramline runs directly through the historic city center to the station.
examples.zh: 一条新铺设的有轨电车线直接穿过历史悠久的市中心通往车站。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tramline 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 专题论文, 研究, 探讨
lemmas.def_en: an elaborate analytical or explanatory essay or discussion

examples.en: The professor published an extensive disquisition examining the philosophical roots of modern democracy.
examples.zh: 这位教授发表了一篇探讨现代民主哲学根源的长篇专题论著。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 disquisition 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 瘦弱, 憔悴, 衰弱
lemmas.def_en: extreme leanness (usually caused by starvation or disease)

examples.en: Prolonged starvation had led to severe emaciation and dangerous weakness in the rescued animals.
examples.zh: 长期的饥饿导致获救动物严重消瘦且极度衰弱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 emaciation 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: not varying

examples.en: The coastal city is popular with retirees because of its mild and equable climate.
examples.zh: 这座沿海城市因其温和且变化不大的气候而受到退休人员的欢迎。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 equable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: relating to erythrocytes

examples.en: The bone marrow biopsy revealed active proliferation of erythroid cells in the patient.
examples.zh: 骨髓活检显示该患者体内的红细胞系细胞呈活跃增生状态。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 erythroid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a naturally occurring estrogenic hormone; a synthetic form is used to treat estrogen deficiency

examples.en: Doctors measured the mother's estriol levels to assess the overall health of the fetus.
examples.zh: 医生测量了母亲体内的雌三醇水平，以评估胎儿的整体健康状况。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 estriol 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a woman executor

examples.en: She was appointed as the sole executrix to manage her late father's estate.
examples.zh: 她被指定为管理已故父亲遗产的唯一女遗嘱执行人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 executrix 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 火烧过的土地上易于生长的草类(如柳叶菜等)
lemmas.def_en: tall North American perennial with creeping rootstocks and narrow leaves and spikes of pinkish-purple flowers occurring in great abundance in burned-over areas or recent clearings; an important honey plant

examples.en: Bright purple fireweed quickly covered the forest floor after the devastating summer wildfire.
examples.zh: 毁灭性的夏季野火过后，亮紫色的柳叶菜迅速覆盖了林地。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fireweed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the muscle in the back part of the leg that forms the greater part of the calf; responsible for the plantar flexion of the foot

examples.en: The sprinter suffered a painful cramp in his left gastrocnemius during the final race.
examples.zh: 短跑运动员在决赛中左侧腓肠肌发生了剧烈抽筋。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gastrocnemius 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a type of dynamite in which the nitroglycerin is absorbed in a base of wood pulp and sodium or potassium nitrate

examples.en: Miners used sticks of gelignite to blast a new passage through the solid granite.
examples.zh: 矿工们使用葛里炸药在坚硬的花岗岩中炸出了一条新通道。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gelignite 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a mathematician specializing in geometry

examples.en: The ancient Greek geometer Euclid laid down the foundational principles of modern geometry.
examples.zh: 古希腊几何学家欧几里得奠定了现代几何学的基础原理。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 geometer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] ('glom onto') (North American slang) To latch onto or attach yourself to someone; to grab or steal.

examples.en: The hungry stray cat tried to glom a piece of fish from the counter.
examples.zh: 那只饥饿的流浪猫试图从柜台上偷抓一块鱼肉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 glom 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any gummy shapeless matter; usually unpleasant

examples.en: The cafeteria served an unappetizing glop of mashed potatoes and lukewarm gravy.
examples.zh: 食堂供应了一份令人毫无食欲、混着温吞肉汁的黏稠土豆泥。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 glop 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 侄孙, 甥外孙, 甥孙, 侄外孙
lemmas.def_en: a son of your niece or nephew

examples.en: The elderly woman left her antique pocket watch to her favorite grandnephew.
examples.zh: 这位老妇人将她的古董怀表留给了她最喜欢的侄孙。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 grandnephew 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 溶血的, 血球溶解的
lemmas.def_en: relating to or involving or causing hemolysis

examples.en: The patient was diagnosed with a rare haemolytic disorder that destroys red blood cells.
examples.zh: 该患者被诊断出患有一种破坏红细胞的罕见溶血性疾病。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 haemolytic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a round piece of luggage for carrying hats

examples.en: She carefully lifted the vintage silk bonnet out of its round leather hatbox.
examples.zh: 她小心翼翼地从圆形皮革帽盒中取出了那顶复古丝绸软帽。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hatbox 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 舱口, 地窑口, 天窗
lemmas.def_en: an entrance equipped with a hatch; especially a passageway between decks of a ship

examples.en: The sailor climbed down the narrow hatchway to inspect the cargo in the hold.
examples.zh: 水手顺着狭窄的舱口爬下去检查货舱里的货物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hatchway 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: poisonous fetid Old World herb having sticky hairy leaves and yellow-brown flowers; yields hyoscyamine and scopolamine

examples.en: Medieval herbalists carefully prepared remedies using small, controlled doses of poisonous henbane.
examples.zh: 中世纪的草药师用极少量且受控的有毒天仙子精心配制药剂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 henbane 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: characteristic of or suffering from kyphosis, an abnormality of the vertebral column

examples.en: An old, humpbacked man slowly made his way across the busy cobblestone street.
examples.zh: 一位驼背的老人步履缓慢地穿过了繁忙的鹅卵石街道。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 humpbacked 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: abnormal condition in which vision for distant objects is better than for near objects

examples.en: Because of his hyperopia, he needs reading glasses to focus on nearby text clearly.
examples.zh: 由于患有远视，他需要老花镜才能看清近处的文字。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hyperopia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the system of religion and philosophy taught by the Druids and their rites and ceremonies

examples.en: The ancient stone monument is widely believed to be closely associated with Celtic druidism.
examples.zh: 人们普遍认为这座古老的石制遗迹与凯尔特德鲁伊教密切相关。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 druidism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 难以言喻地, 因神圣而不容称呼地
lemmas.def_en: to an inexpressible degree

examples.en: Standing atop the mountain peak, she felt an ineffably peaceful connection with nature.
examples.zh: 站在山顶之上，她感到一种难以言喻的、与自然的宁静联结。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ineffably 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a hanging fold of loose skin on an elderly person's neck

examples.en: The resting bull lazily brushed away flies hovering near its thick, hanging dewlap.
examples.zh: 休憩的公牛懒洋洋地拂开盘旋在它厚重下垂颈肉附近的苍蝇。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dewlap 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having antlers

examples.en: A magnificent antlered stag stepped gracefully out from the mist of the dense woods.
examples.zh: 一头长着雄伟鹿角的公鹿优雅地从茂密树林的迷雾中走了出来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 antlered 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: South American armadillo with three bands of bony plates

examples.en: The Brazilian three-banded armadillo, commonly known as the apar, can roll into a ball.
examples.zh: 通常被称为apar的巴西三带犰狳能够将身体蜷缩成一个球。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 apar 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the earliest known rocks formed during the Precambrian Eon

examples.en: Geologists collected rare rock samples formed during the ancient Archaean era for analysis.
examples.zh: 地质学家采集了形成于遥远太古代时期的罕见岩石样本进行分析。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 archaean 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a serviceman in the artillery

examples.en: The young artilleryman carefully calculated the coordinates before firing the heavy field gun.
examples.zh: 年轻的炮兵在发射重型野战炮前仔细计算了坐标。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 artilleryman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a woman author

examples.en: The celebrated authoress held a lively book-signing session for her latest historical novel.
examples.zh: 这位著名女作家为她最新的历史小说举办了一场热闹的新书签售会。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 authoress 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 常衡, 体重, 肥胖
lemmas.def_en: a system of weights based on the 16-ounce pound (or 7,000 grains)

examples.en: After the holidays, he decided to exercise regularly to shed some extra avoirdupois.
examples.zh: 假期结束后，他决定经常锻炼以减掉身上多余的体重。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 avoirdupois 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: when dried yields a hard substance used e.g. in golf balls

examples.en: Manufacturers once used resilient natural balata to produce durable covers for golf balls.
examples.zh: 制造商曾使用有弹性的天然巴拉塔树胶来制作耐用的高尔夫球外皮。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 balata 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a commercial leavening agent containing yeast cells; used to raise the dough in making bread and for fermenting beer or whiskey

examples.en: The traditional baker scooped the frothy barm from the fermenting beer to leaven bread.
examples.zh: 这位传统面包师从发酵的啤酒中舀出泡沫状的酵母来发酵面包。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 barm 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a strong post (as on a wharf or quay or ship for attaching mooring lines)

examples.en: The sailor secured the heavy mooring rope firmly around the wooden bitt on deck.
examples.zh: 水手把沉重的系泊缆绳牢牢系在甲板上的木质系缆柱上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bitt 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the launching of a missile or spacecraft to a specified destination

examples.en: Spectators cheered as the massive rocket lifted into the sky right after blastoff.
examples.zh: 火箭升空后，围观的人群欢呼雀跃，目送庞大的火箭冲入云霄。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 blastoff 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: obstinate and stupid

examples.en: He was too bullheaded to admit his obvious mistake and change his original plan.
examples.zh: 他太顽固了，不肯承认明显的错误并改变原定计划。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bullheaded 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 围堰, 隔离舱, 潜水箱
lemmas.def_en: large watertight chamber used for construction under water

examples.en: Engineers built a temporary cofferdam to keep the riverbed dry during foundation repairs.
examples.zh: 工程师们建造了一个临时围堰，以便在地基维修期间保持河床干燥。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cofferdam 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a conceited dandy who is overly impressed by his own accomplishments

examples.en: The vain coxcomb spent hours adjusting his velvet coat before entering the ballroom.
examples.zh: 那个虚荣的花花公子在进入舞厅前花了几个小时整理他的天鹅绒外套。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coxcomb 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 嘎扎嘎扎的咬嚼, 压碎, 扎扎地踏过
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (archaic variant of crunch) To crush or grind noisily with the teeth or feet.

examples.en: Our boots began to cranch loudly across the crisp, frozen snow along the path.
examples.zh: 我们的靴子踩在小路上清脆的冻雪上，发出嘎吱嘎吱的声响。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cranch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having cusps or points

examples.en: The ancient cathedral featured elegant windows decorated with beautifully sculpted, cusped stone arches.
examples.zh: 这座古老的大教堂拥有饰有雕刻精美、带尖角石拱的优雅窗户。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cusped 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: ten-armed oval-bodied cephalopod with narrow fins as long as the body and a large calcareous internal shell

examples.en: A frightened cuttle squirted a cloud of dark ink to confuse the approaching predator.
examples.zh: 一只受惊的墨鱼喷出一团黑墨，以迷惑逼近的捕食者。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cuttle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 匍生的, 爬在地上的, 匍匐的
lemmas.def_en: lying down; in a position of comfort or rest

examples.en: The gardener planted decumbent herbs that spread across the ground before growing upright.
examples.zh: 园丁种植了先贴地蔓生然后再向上生长的匍匐草本植物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 decumbent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可记述的, 可描写的
lemmas.def_en: capable of being described

examples.en: Her profound sense of relief after the ordeal was barely describable in simple words.
examples.zh: 苦难过后她那由衷的释怀感，很难用简单的言语来描述。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 describable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an abnormal condition in males in which the urethra opens on the under surface of the penis

examples.en: The pediatric surgeon successfully corrected the infant's hypospadias during a routine procedure.
examples.zh: 小儿外科医生在一次常规手术中成功矫正了婴儿的尿道下裂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hypospadias 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 赞美诗, 歌唱赞美诗, 赞美诗研究
lemmas.def_en: the act of singing psalms or hymns

examples.en: Scholars of Christian hymnody study the evolution of sacred choral songs through the centuries.
examples.zh: 研究基督教赞美诗的学者们探究了几个世纪以来宗教合唱歌曲的演变。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hymnody 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: somewhat strange

examples.en: I noticed an oddish metallic taste in the soup and decided not to finish it.
examples.zh: 我注意到汤里有一股古怪的金属味，于是决定不喝了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 oddish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 是火腿；火腿肉；火腿肉一片
lemmas.def_en: meat cut from the thigh of a hog (usually smoked)

examples.en: He ordered a warm, crusty baguette filled with savory jambon and melted Swiss cheese.
examples.zh: 他点了一根夹着美味火腿和融化瑞士奶酪的温热香脆法棍。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jambon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: reddish long-tailed monkey of west Africa

examples.en: The agile patas dashed across the open savannah, easily outrunning most woodland monkeys.
examples.zh: 敏捷的赤猴飞奔穿过开阔的稀树草原，速度轻松超过多数林栖猴类。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 patas 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small flashlight resembling a fountain pen

examples.en: The doctor clicked on his pocket penlight to inspect the patient's dilated pupils.
examples.zh: 医生按下口袋里的笔式小手电筒，检查患者放大的瞳孔。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 penlight 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an oxide containing five atoms of oxygen in the molecule

examples.en: Phosphorus pentoxide reacts violently with water to form highly concentrated, acidic phosphoric acid.
examples.zh: 五氧化二磷与水剧烈反应，生成高浓度的酸性磷酸。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pentoxide 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: inflammation of a vein (usually in the legs)

examples.en: The elderly patient developed painful phlebitis in his left leg after prolonged bed rest.
examples.zh: 长期卧床后，这位老年患者的左腿引发了疼痛的静脉炎。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 phlebitis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 占卜写板(搞迷信活动用的一种道具)
lemmas.def_en: a triangular board supported on casters; when lightly touched with the fingertips it is supposed to spell out supernatural (or unconscious) messages

examples.en: The curious teenagers watched the wooden planchette glide mysteriously across the letter board.
examples.zh: 好奇的青少年们注视着木制占卜写板在字母盘上神秘地滑动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 planchette 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: one who believes in a plurality of gods

examples.en: As a devout polytheist, the ancient Greek citizen prayed to various regional deities daily.
examples.zh: 作为一名虔诚的多神教徒，这位古希腊公民每天向不同的地方神祇祈祷。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 polytheist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (以糊口而写的)粗制滥造文艺作品, 粗制滥造作品的人
lemmas.def_en: a literary composition of poor quality that was written quickly to make money (to boil the pot)

examples.en: The novelist quickly churned out another formulaic thriller potboiler just to pay his rent.
examples.zh: 这位小说家为了付房租，匆忙炮制了另一部公式化的粗制滥造惊悚小说。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 potboiler 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 刑事推事, 主管财务官吏
lemmas.def_en: any of several public officials of ancient Rome (usually in charge of finance and administration)

examples.en: The young Roman politician began his public career by serving as a quaestor.
examples.zh: 这位年轻的罗马政客从担任财务官开始了他的仕途。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 quaestor 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: resistor for regulating current

examples.en: Turn the rheostat gently to adjust the brightness of the stage lights.
examples.zh: 轻轻旋转变阻器以调节舞台灯光的亮度。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rheostat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a physician who specializes in surgery

examples.en: The wounded soldier begged the sawbones to save his injured leg.
examples.zh: 受伤的士兵恳求外科医生保住他受伤的腿。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sawbones 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small pruning shears with a spring that holds the handles open and a single blade that closes against a flat surface

examples.en: She used sharp secateurs to prune the dead branches from the rosebush.
examples.zh: 她用锋利的修枝剪修剪玫瑰丛上的枯枝。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 secateurs 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 感觉中枢, 感觉器官
lemmas.def_en: the areas of the brain that process and register incoming sensory information and make possible the conscious awareness of the world

examples.en: The vibrant colors and loud music overwhelmed his delicate sensorium completely.
examples.zh: 鲜艳的色彩和嘈杂的音乐彻底压垮了他的感官中枢。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sensorium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (of a leaf shape) having a broad rounded apex and a narrow base

examples.en: The frog has spatulate toes that help it paddle through murky water.
examples.zh: 这只青蛙长着铲状的脚趾，有助于在浑水中划行。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spatulate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可使用的, 可花费的
lemmas.def_en: (used of funds) remaining after taxes

examples.en: After paying his monthly rent, he had very little spendable income left.
examples.zh: 付完月租后，他剩下的可支配收入所剩无几。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spendable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small needlelike appendage; especially the feeding organ of a tardigrade

examples.en: The nurse carefully inserted a thin stylet into the flexible medical catheter.
examples.zh: 护士小心地将一根细探针插入柔软的医用导管中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stylet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 塔博勒色拉(一种黎巴嫩生菜)
lemmas.def_en: a finely chopped salad with tomatoes and parsley and mint and scallions and bulgur wheat

examples.en: We ordered fresh tabbouleh tossed with parsley, mint, and lemon juice.
examples.zh: 我们点了拌有欧芹、薄荷和柠檬汁的新鲜塔博勒色拉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tabbouleh 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a lever that is moved in order to tap something else

examples.en: A worn engine tappet was causing an annoying clicking noise under the hood.
examples.zh: 磨损的发动机梃杆在引擎盖下发出恼人的咔嗒声。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tappet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: cell that functions in the breakdown and resorption of bone tissue

examples.en: An active osteoclast breaks down old bone tissue to allow for new growth.
examples.zh: 活跃的破骨细胞会分解旧骨组织以促进新骨生长。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 osteoclast 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who travels about selling his wares (as on the streets or at carnivals)

examples.en: The traveling packman sold ribbons and sewing needles to isolated rural villagers.
examples.zh: 走街串巷的小贩向偏远乡村的村民出售丝带和缝衣针。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 packman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a persistent but subordinate motif

examples.en: The soprano's aria was accompanied by a delicate violin obbligato throughout.
examples.zh: 女高音的咏叹调全程伴随着优美细腻的小提琴伴奏。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 obbligato 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (Yiddish) a long boring tediously detailed account

examples.en: He turned a simple flat tire into an endless megillah of complaints.
examples.zh: 他把一次简单的爆胎变成了没完没了的牢骚长篇大论。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 megillah 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 屠马业者, 收买废屋船业者
lemmas.def_en: someone who buys old buildings or ships and breaks them up to recover the materials in them

examples.en: The old injured horse was sold to a knacker for minimal cash.
examples.zh: 那匹年老受伤的马被以极低的价钱卖给了屠马商。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 knacker 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (Yiddish) a baked or fried turnover filled with potato or meat or cheese; often eaten as a snack

examples.en: She grabbed a warm potato knish from the corner bakery for lunch.
examples.zh: 她从街角面包店买了一个热乎乎的土豆馅饼当午餐。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 knish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: caught in European waters; slenderer than American lobster

examples.en: The seaside restaurant served grilled langoustine drizzled with rich garlic butter.
examples.zh: 这家海滨餐厅供应淋有浓郁蒜蓉黄油的烤海螯虾。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 langoustine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a spear with three or more prongs; used for spearing fish (especially salmon)

examples.en: The poacher used a three-pronged leister to spear salmon in the shallow river.
examples.zh: 偷猎者用一把三股鱼叉在浅河中刺鲑鱼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 leister 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: man with strong sexual desires

examples.en: She avoided the old letch who always made inappropriate comments at parties.
examples.zh: 她避开了那个总是在派对上发表不当言论的老色鬼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 letch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an abnormal lowering of the white blood cell count

examples.en: The doctor monitored her blood counts carefully because chemotherapy often causes leukopenia.
examples.zh: 医生仔细监测她的血常规，因为化疗常常会导致白细胞减少。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 leukopenia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a solid solution of carbon in alpha-iron that is formed when steel is cooled so rapidly that the change from austenite to pearlite is suppressed; responsible for the hardness of quenched steel

examples.en: Rapid water quenching transformed the hot steel into an extremely hard martensite.
examples.zh: 快速水淬将热钢转变为极其坚硬的马氏体。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 martensite 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: dried cod soaked in a lye solution before boiling to give it a gelatinous consistency

examples.en: Every Christmas Eve, the Scandinavian family prepares traditional lutefisk with melted butter.
examples.zh: 每年平安夜，这个斯堪的纳维亚家庭都会配着融化的黄油制作传统的碱渍鱼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lutefisk 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: religious texts from Deuteronomy inscribed on parchment and rolled up in a case that is attached to the doorframe of many Jewish households in accordance with Jewish law

examples.en: He touched the decorative mezuzah on the doorpost before entering the apartment.
examples.zh: 他在进入公寓前轻触了门柱上装饰精致的圣卷。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mezuzah 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 海军军校学员, 水手衫
lemmas.def_en: blouse with a sailor collar

examples.en: The young middy stood proudly on deck during the naval parade.
examples.zh: 在海军检阅仪式上，年轻的水兵骄傲地站在甲板上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 middy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: abnormally intense sexual desire in women

examples.en: The historical novel touches on her tragic struggle with nymphomania.
examples.zh: 这部历史小说涉及了她与慕男狂抗争的悲剧经历。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nymphomania 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having more than one story

examples.en: A new multistorey car park is being built near the station.
examples.zh: 车站附近正在建造一座新的多层停车场。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 multistorey 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 挤奶人, 挤奶器, 乳牛
lemmas.def_en: cattle that are reared for their milk

examples.en: The dairy farm upgraded to an automated milker to boost production.
examples.zh: 该奶牛场升级了自动挤奶器以提高产量。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 milker 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不当行为, 行为失检, 侵犯他人权利的行为
lemmas.def_en: doing a proper act in a wrongful or injurious manner

examples.en: The public official faced severe penalties for misfeasance in office.
examples.zh: 该官员因任内渎职行为面临严厉处罚。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 misfeasance 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to an inheritable character that is controlled by a single pair of genes

examples.en: Cystic fibrosis is one of the most widely studied monogenic disorders.
examples.zh: 囊性纤维化是研究最广泛的单基因遗传病之一。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 monogenic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (botany / formal) To fold into neat, fan-like pleats.

examples.en: Carefully plicate the fabric along the edges to create neat pleats.
examples.zh: 沿着边缘仔细地把织物折成整齐的褶裥。

lemmas.def_zh: 折襞, 皱纹, 细褶皱
lemmas.def_en: an angular or rounded shape made by folding

examples.en: a fold in the napkin
a crease in his trousers

family_guide.root_logic: 以 plicate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 酿酒学, 葡萄酒工艺学
lemmas.def_en: the art of wine making

examples.en: She pursued a degree in oenology to manage her family vineyard.
examples.zh: 为了打理家族葡萄园，她攻读了酿酒学学位。

lemmas.def_en: a specialist in wine making

family_guide.root_logic: 以 oenology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: worn and broken down by hard use

examples.en: He sat on the bench with a woebegone expression on his face.
examples.zh: 他坐在长椅上，脸上带着一副愁眉苦脸的表情。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 woebegone 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: not soured or preserved

examples.en: This sweet beverage is made from the fresh unfermented juice of grapes.
examples.zh: 这种甜饮是用新鲜未发酵的葡萄汁制成的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unfermented 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the internal supporting structure that gives an artifact its shape

examples.en: Rust on the vehicle's underframe can compromise its structural safety.
examples.zh: 车辆底架生锈可能会危及其结构安全性。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 underframe 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 略为肿大的, 稍许肿胀的
lemmas.def_en: abnormally distended especially by fluids or gas

examples.en: The doctor examined the tumescent tissue around the infected wound.
examples.zh: 医生检查了受感染伤口周围略微肿胀的组织。

lemmas.def_zh: 肿胀, 肿大, 肿大部分
lemmas.def_en: tumidity resulting from the presence of blood or other fluid in the tissues

examples.en: The physician noted significant tumescence around the injury and applied a cold compress immediately.
examples.zh: 医生注意到伤口周围有明显的肿胀，立即进行了冷敷。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tumescent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a bacterial toxin that has been weakened until it is no longer toxic but is strong enough to induce the formation of antibodies and immunity to the specific disease caused by the toxin

examples.en: Children receive a tetanus toxoid vaccine as part of standard immunization.
examples.zh: 儿童接种破伤风类毒素疫苗作为常规免疫的一部分。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 toxoid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: one of the bottle-shaped pins used in bowling

examples.en: He knocked down the final tenpin to secure victory for his team.
examples.zh: 他击倒最后一根保龄球柱，为全队锁定了胜利。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tenpin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the longest and thickest bone of the human skeleton; extends from the pelvis to the knee

examples.en: The athlete suffered a serious fracture of his thighbone during the match.
examples.zh: 该运动员在比赛中不幸遭遇严重的大腿骨骨折。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 thighbone 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: pain in a joint or joints

examples.en: Patients with viral infections often complain of sudden fatigue and severe arthralgia.
examples.zh: 病毒感染患者常自诉突然疲劳并伴有严重关节痛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 arthralgia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: hard strong durable yellowish-brown wood of teak trees; resistant to insects and to warping; used for furniture and in shipbuilding

examples.en: This handcrafted dining table was made of solid teakwood from Myanmar.
examples.zh: 这张手工餐桌是由产自缅甸的实心柚木制成的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 teakwood 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an opening (in a wall or ship or armored vehicle) for firing through

examples.en: The archer took aim through a narrow embrasure in the castle wall.
examples.zh: 弓箭手透过城墙上狭窄的箭眼瞄准目标。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 embrasure 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: tastelessly showy

examples.en: The street market was filled with cheap toys and gimcrack souvenirs.
examples.zh: 街市上到处都是廉价玩具和华而不实的纪念品。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gimcrack 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: paper that is poisoned or coated with a sticky substance to kill flies

examples.en: Several dead insects were stuck fast to the strip of flypaper.
examples.zh: 几只死昆虫紧紧地粘在捕蝇纸条上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 flypaper 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 受有封地的, 封地的, 封臣的
lemmas.def_en: of or pertaining to the relation of a feudal vassal to his lord

examples.en: The monarch demanded an annual tribute from each feudatory state.
examples.zh: 君主向每个受封的附庸邦国索要年贡。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 feudatory 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 模仿交感神经作用的, 拟交感的
lemmas.def_en: relating to epinephrine (its release or action)

examples.en: The doctor prescribed a sympathomimetic spray to quickly relieve nasal congestion.
examples.zh: 医生开了一种拟交感神经喷雾剂以迅速缓解鼻塞。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sympathomimetic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the joint between the cannon bone and the pastern

examples.en: The racehorse injured its left fetlock during the final training session.
examples.zh: 那匹赛马在最后一次训练中伤到了左球节。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fetlock 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: one of the eight bones of the cranium; a small bone filled with air spaces that forms part of the eye sockets and the nasal cavity

examples.en: A deep fracture affected the ethmoid bone behind his nasal cavity.
examples.zh: 一处深层骨折累及了他鼻腔后方的筛骨。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ethmoid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: surgical removal of something without cutting into it

examples.en: The surgeon successfully performed an enucleation to remove the ocular tumor.
examples.zh: 外科医生成功进行了眼球摘除术以切除肿瘤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 enucleation 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a boat for communication between ship and shore

examples.en: The captain ordered the crew to lower the pinnace into the water.
examples.zh: 船长命令船员将大舢板放入水中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pinnace 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: impaired articulatory ability resulting from defects in the peripheral motor nerves or in the speech musculature

examples.en: After the minor stroke, he suffered from temporary dysarthria and slurred speech.
examples.zh: 轻度中风后，他出现了暂时的构音障碍和口齿不清。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dysarthria 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: stems of beans and peas and potatoes and grasses collectively as used for thatching and bedding

examples.en: The dry potato halm was collected and burned after the harvest season.
examples.zh: 收获季节过后，干燥的马铃薯茎秆被收集并焚烧。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 halm 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 精神有点失常的, 喝醉了的, 着魔似的, 淘气的, 怪癖的
lemmas.def_en: naughtily or annoyingly playful

examples.en: His pixilated behavior at the formal dinner embarrassed all of his colleagues.
examples.zh: 他在正式晚宴上醉醺醺的古怪举止让所有同事都感到尴尬。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pixilated 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可溶解的, 可解散的, 可分解的
lemmas.def_en: capable of dissolving

examples.en: The doctor used dissolvable stitches that would disappear naturally within two weeks.
examples.zh: 医生使用了会在两周内自然吸收的可溶解缝合线。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dissolvable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: constitutional predisposition to a particular disease or abnormality

examples.en: The patient had an inherited diathesis that made him prone to allergies.
examples.zh: 该患者具有遗传性过敏体质，容易发生过敏反应。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 diathesis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the part between the fetlock and the hoof

examples.en: The veterinarian carefully examined the horse's swollen pastern after the morning race.
examples.zh: 晨赛结束后，兽医仔细检查了马匹肿胀的系部。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pastern 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: inducing perspiration

examples.en: Drinking hot ginger tea serves as an effective diaphoretic remedy for colds.
examples.zh: 喝热姜茶是一种治疗感冒的有效发汗方法。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 diaphoretic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: frenzied as if possessed by a demon

examples.en: The villain let out a demoniac laugh that terrified everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 恶魔般的反派发出一阵狂笑，吓坏了屋里的所有人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 demoniac 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 很快地吃[或喝], 贪婪地吃[或喝]
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (+ down/up) (North American slang) To eat or drink something quickly and greedily.

examples.en: The hungry teenagers snarfed down the entire pizza in just five minutes.
examples.zh: 饥饿的青少年们在短短五分钟内就狼吞虎咽地吃光了整张披萨。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 snarf 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an excavation; usually a quarry or mine

examples.en: Her grandmother collected antique delf tiles painted with classic blue windmill patterns.
examples.zh: 她祖母收集了绘有经典蓝色风车图案的代尔夫特古董瓷砖。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 delf 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: dialysis of the blood to remove toxic substances or metabolic wastes from the bloodstream; used in the case of kidney failure

examples.en: Patients with severe kidney failure usually require haemodialysis three times a week.
examples.zh: 重度肾衰竭患者通常需要每周进行三次血液透析。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 haemodialysis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: not wearing a hat

examples.en: He walked hatless through the sudden downpour and got completely soaked today.
examples.zh: 今天，他光着头走在突如其来的暴雨中，浑身湿透。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hatless 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 透支(银行帐户), 把(弓等)拉得过度, 夸大, 夸张；透支
lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (banking) To spend more money from your bank account than you actually have in it; to exaggerate.

examples.en: Be careful with your debit card so that you do not overdraw.
examples.zh: 使用借记卡时要小心，以免透支账户。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 overdraw 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 等压线, 同重元素, 同重核
lemmas.def_en: (meteorology)an isogram connecting points having equal barometric pressure at a given time

examples.en: The meteorologist pointed to a tightly packed isobar on the weather map.
examples.zh: 气象学家指着天气图上一条密集分布的等压线。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 isobar 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a plate mounted on the front and back of car and bearing the car's registration number

examples.en: The traffic camera clearly captured the speeding vehicle's rear numberplate at night.
examples.zh: 交通摄像头在夜间清晰地拍下了超速车辆的后车牌。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 numberplate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （尤指前苏联等国家由共产党任命的）要职人员
lemmas.def_en: the system of patronage in communist countries; controlled by committees in the Communist Party

examples.en: Members of the Soviet nomenklatura enjoyed special privileges inaccessible to ordinary citizens.
examples.zh: 苏联高层要职人员享有普通公民无法获得的特殊特权。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nomenklatura 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: being three more than sixty

examples.en: Please turn to chapter LXIII to read about the decisive final battle.
examples.zh: 请翻到第63章，阅读关于决定性决战的内容。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lxiii 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 或者, 偶然, 不料
lemmas.def_en: by chance

examples.en: If peradventure he should arrive early, please ask him to wait here.
examples.zh: 倘若他偶然早到了，请让他在此稍候。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 peradventure 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or near the small of the back and the back part of the pelvis between the hips

examples.en: Heavy lifting without proper posture can lead to severe lumbosacral joint pain.
examples.zh: 姿势不当搬运重物会导致严重的腰骶关节疼痛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lumbosacral 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of humble birth or origins

examples.en: Despite his lowborn origins, the young knight rose to become royal advisor.
examples.zh: 尽管出身低微，这位年轻的骑士最终升任为皇家顾问。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lowborn 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [生理](尤指脑部的)偏侧性, 偏侧优势,偏利
lemmas.def_en: localization of function on either the right or left sides of the brain

examples.en: Language processing typically demonstrates a clear leftward lateralization in human brains.
examples.zh: 人类大脑的语言处理通常表现出明显的左侧偏利性。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lateralization 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (medicine) blowing air or medicated powder into the lungs (or into some other body cavity)

examples.en: The pharmacist explained that nasal insufflation allows rapid absorption of the medication.
examples.zh: 药剂师解释说，鼻腔吹入法能让药物迅速被吸收。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 insufflation 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a dining-room attendant who is in charge of the waiters and the seating of customers

examples.en: The polite headwaiter guided the guests to their reserved table by window.
examples.zh: 彬彬有礼的服务员领班引着客人们来到窗边预订的桌位。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 headwaiter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 声脉冲发送器, 铃声定时器
lemmas.def_en: a pulse generator used for echo sounding in sonar

examples.en: The search team tracked the acoustic pinger attached to the missing black box.
examples.zh: 搜寻队追踪了连接在失踪黑匣子上的声学脉冲发生器。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pinger 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: capable of developing an immune response following exposure to an antigen

examples.en: Only immunocompetent patients were selected to participate in the experimental vaccine trial.
examples.zh: 只有免疫系统正常的患者被选中参加该试验性疫苗测试。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 immunocompetent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a graphic character that indicates the meaning of a thing without indicating the sounds used to say it

examples.en: Each Chinese ideogram often conveys a complex meaning beyond its basic visual form.
examples.zh: 每个汉字表意文字通常都传达着超越其基础字形的复杂含义。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ideogram 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: doglike nocturnal mammal of Africa and southern Asia that feeds chiefly on carrion

examples.en: A lone hyaena prowled around the campsite in search of leftover food.
examples.zh: 一只落单的鬣狗在营地周围徘徊，寻找吃剩的食物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hyaena 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a motley assortment of things

examples.en: His latest essay was merely a hotchpotch of unverified facts and opinions.
examples.zh: 他最新的文章不过是未经验证的事实和观点的杂烩。
