family_guide.root_logic: 以 hotchpotch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: one of various similar homeotic genes that are involved in bodily segmentation during embryonic development

examples.en: Mutations within a homeobox gene can dramatically alter normal anatomical development.
examples.zh: 同源框基因内部的突变会极大地改变正常的解剖发育。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 homeobox 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a large sandwich made of a long crusty roll split lengthwise and filled with meats and cheese (and tomato and onion and lettuce and condiments); different names are used in different sections of the United States

examples.en: He ordered a massive turkey hoagy with extra cheese for lunch.
examples.zh: 他午餐点了一个加了双份奶酪的特大号火鸡三明治。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hoagy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 当劳役偿债, 服劳役(法)
lemmas.def_en: the condition of a peon

examples.en: Many impoverished farmers were trapped in debt peonage for several generations.
examples.zh: 许多贫困农民陷入了长达数代的债务劳役之中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 peonage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: North American moth whose larvae feed on young plant stems cutting them off at the ground

examples.en: A single cutworm can sever a tender tomato seedling at the ground level.
examples.zh: 一只切根虫就能从地面齐根咬断一株幼嫩的番茄幼苗。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cutworm 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the lean flesh of a cod-like fish of North Atlantic waters

examples.en: The fisherman was surprised to catch a deepwater cusk near the rocky reef.
examples.zh: 渔民很惊讶在岩礁附近捕到了一条深海单鳍鳕。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cusk 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: nocturnal gregarious pig-like wild animals of North America and South America

examples.en: A small herd of peccary darted through the dense desert scrubland.
examples.zh: 一小群野猪穿过了茂密的沙漠灌木丛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 peccary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the manufacture of sections of a building at the factory so they can be easily and rapidly assembled at the building site

examples.en: Modern prefabrication methods drastically cut construction time for affordable housing projects.
examples.zh: 现代预制构件制造方法大大缩短了经济适用房项目的施工时间。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 prefabrication 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: inflammation of the eyelids characterized by redness and swelling and dried crusts

examples.en: Warm compresses can help soothe the irritation caused by chronic blepharitis.
examples.zh: 热敷有助于缓解慢性睑缘炎引起的刺痛不适。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 blepharitis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 铁道模式；铁路广场；铁路院
lemmas.def_en: an area having a network of railway tracks and sidings for storage and maintenance of cars and engines

examples.en: Dozens of freight trains sat idle in the massive railyard overnight.
examples.zh: 数十列货运列车整夜停放在巨大的铁路编组场中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 railyard 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: exerting a favorable or beneficent influence

examples.en: Astrologers consider Jupiter to be a benefic planet that brings good fortune.
examples.zh: 占星家认为木星是一颗能带来好运的吉星。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 benefic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: tissue that is taken from one site and grafted to another site on the same person

examples.en: The surgeon used a skin autograft from the thigh to cover the burn.
examples.zh: 外科医生使用患者大腿上的自体移植皮肤来覆盖烧伤处。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 autograft 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the lower layer of the crust

examples.en: Tectonic plates float and slide upon the semi-fluid layer called the asthenosphere.
examples.zh: 构造板块在被称为软流圈的半流体层上漂浮和滑动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 asthenosphere 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 埋伏, 伏兵, 埋伏处
lemmas.def_en: the act of concealing yourself and lying in wait to attack by surprise

examples.en: The soldiers walked directly into an ambuscade set by the hidden enemy.
examples.zh: 士兵们直接走进了潜伏敌人设下的埋伏圈。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ambuscade 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [植]苎麻,（纺织等用的）苎麻纤维
lemmas.def_en: tall perennial herb of tropical Asia with dark green leaves; cultivated for the fiber from its woody stems that resembles flax

examples.en: This lightweight summer shirt is woven from a blend of cotton and ramie.
examples.zh: 这件轻便的夏装衬衫由棉和苎麻混纺织成。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ramie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [植] 十字花科的一年生植物, 香雪球
lemmas.def_en: any garden plant of the genus Alyssum having clusters of small yellow or white flowers

examples.en: Sweet alyssum formed a fragrant carpet of tiny white flowers along the path.
examples.zh: 香雪球沿小径形成了一张散发着芬芳的白色碎花地毯。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 alyssum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the place where you are after you die

examples.en: Ancient Egyptian rituals were designed to ensure safe passage into the peaceful afterworld.
examples.zh: 古埃及的仪式旨在确保人们安全通往安宁的来世。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 afterworld 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a blade that has very sharp edge

examples.en: Be careful when replacing the rusty razorblade in that old metal scraper.
examples.zh: 更换那个旧金属刮刀里生锈的刀片时要小心。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 razorblade 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不等边的, 倾轴的, 斜角肌的
lemmas.def_en: of a triangle having three sides of different lengths

examples.en: The teacher asked the class to calculate the perimeter of a scalene triangle.
examples.zh: 老师要求全班同学计算一个不等边三角形的周长。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scalene 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of various brown and yellow finches of parts of Europe

examples.en: A tiny serin sang cheerfully from the top branch of the olive tree.
examples.zh: 一只小巧的丝雀在橄榄树的顶枝上欢快地鸣叫。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 serin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the amount of cargo that can be held by a boat or ship or a freight car

examples.en: The harbor workers worked through the night to unload a shipload of grain.
examples.zh: 港口工人整夜工作以卸下整船的粮食。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shipload 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of a large class of compounds that have alternate silicon and oxygen atoms

examples.en: The chemist applied a protective siloxane coating to make the glass surface waterproof.
examples.zh: 化学家涂上了一层保护性硅氧烷涂层，使玻璃表面防水。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 siloxane 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a conspicuous bract surrounding or subtending a spadix or other inflorescence

examples.en: A large greenish spathe enclosed the flower spike of the peace lily.
examples.zh: 一个巨大的浅绿色佛焰苞包裹着白鹤芋的花序。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spathe 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 小型拨弦古钢琴, 小型立式钢琴
lemmas.def_en: a small and compactly built upright piano

examples.en: She played a delicate Baroque melody on the antique spinet in the parlor.
examples.zh: 她在客厅那架古老的小型拨弦古钢琴上弹奏了一曲优美的巴洛克旋律。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 spinet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the act of someone who fishes as a diversion

examples.en: They rented a sturdy boat for a weekend of offshore sportfishing in the gulf.
examples.zh: 他们租了一艘结实的船，去海湾进行周末近海垂钓。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sportfishing 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (poetic) still or calm

examples.en: A gentle breeze barely disturbed the stilly waters of the secluded mountain lake.
examples.zh: 微风掠过，几乎没有惊动幽静高山湖泊平静的水面。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stilly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a tube through which darts can be shot by blowing

examples.en: The hunter quietly raised his bamboo blowgun to target the bird in the canopy.
examples.zh: 猎人悄悄举起竹制吹箭筒，瞄准树冠上的鸟。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 blowgun 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a cricket ball bowled as if to break one way that actually breaks in the opposite way

examples.en: The crafty bowler fooled the batsman completely with an unexpected bosie.
examples.zh: 这位老练的投球手用一个出人意料的曲球彻底骗过了击球手。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bosie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: <美>(合法入境干农活的) 墨西哥短期合同工
lemmas.def_en: a Mexican laborer who worked in the United States on farms and railroads in order to ease labor shortages during World War II

examples.en: His grandfather worked as a bracero on California farms during the harvest season.
examples.zh: 他的祖父曾在收获季节作为墨西哥短期合同工在加州农场工作。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bracero 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the lowest brass wind instrument

examples.en: He marched proudly in the parade while carrying the heavy brass sousaphone.
examples.zh: 他扛着沉重的黄铜苏萨号，自豪地在游行队伍中行进。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sousaphone 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: extreme greed for material wealth

examples.en: His blatant cupidity eventually led him to betray his closest business partners.
examples.zh: 他赤裸裸的贪婪最终导致他背叛了最亲密的商业伙伴。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cupidity 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 舒适的地方, 文件架
lemmas.def_en: a small compartment

examples.en: She organized the mail neatly into each teacher's designated cubbyhole.
examples.zh: 她把邮件整齐地归整进每位老师指定的文件格里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cubbyhole 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the remains of a dead body after cremation

examples.en: The family gathered together by the cliff to scatter their grandfather's cremains.
examples.zh: 一家人聚集在悬崖边，撒散祖父的骨灰。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cremains 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: intended to prevent terrorism

examples.en: The government launched a joint counterterror operation to neutralize the threat.
examples.zh: 政府发起了一次联合反恐行动，以消除该威胁。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 counterterror 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a proposal offered as an alternative to an earlier proposal

examples.en: Management reviewed the union's counterproposal before continuing the wage negotiations.
examples.zh: 管理层在继续进行工资谈判前审阅了工会的反建议。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 counterproposal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: soft lump or unevenness in a yarn; either an imperfection or created by design

examples.en: The natural slub in the linen fabric gave the shirt an attractive texture.
examples.zh: 亚麻面料中的天然竹节让这件衬衫具有迷人的质感。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 slub 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: lightweight parka; waterproof

examples.en: He pulled the hood of his waterproof cagoule tight against the driving rain.
examples.zh: 他拉紧防水连帽薄风衣的兜帽，以抵御滂沱大雨。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cagoule 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a hormone produced by the anterior pituitary gland that stimulates the adrenal cortex

examples.en: The pituitary gland naturally releases corticotropin to trigger the production of cortisol.
examples.zh: 脑下垂体自然释放促肾上腺皮质激素以触发皮质醇的产生。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 corticotropin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 结婚的, 夫妇的, 配偶的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to marriage or to the relationship between a wife and husband

examples.en: The elderly couple celebrated fifty years of quiet and enduring connubial bliss.
examples.zh: 这对老夫妇庆祝了五十年平静而持久的婚姻幸福。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 connubial 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 一致的, 适合的, 符合的
lemmas.def_en: corresponding in character or kind

examples.en: His calm and polite reaction was entirely congruous with his gentle personality.
examples.zh: 他平静礼貌的反应与他温和的性格完全相称。

lemmas.def_zh: 适合, 一致, 共同点
lemmas.def_en: the quality of agreeing; being suitable and appropriate

examples.en: The architect aimed for perfect congruity between the modern extension and historical house.
examples.zh: 建筑师力求在现代扩建部分与历史老宅之间实现完美的一致性。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 congruous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: in a conformable manner

examples.en: The workers acted strictly and conformably to the company safety guidelines.
examples.zh: 工人们严格顺从地遵照公司的安全准则行事。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 conformably 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a style that involves indirect ways of expressing things

examples.en: The politician relied on evasive circumlocution rather than giving a direct answer.
examples.zh: 这位政客借助闪烁其词的迂回说法，而不是给出直接回答。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 circumlocution 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 慎重选择的, 好挑剔的
lemmas.def_en: difficult to please

examples.en: He has always been extremely choosey when selecting vegetables at the market.
examples.zh: 他在市场上挑选蔬菜时一向极其挑剔。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 choosey 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: containing or impregnated with or tasting of iron

examples.en: Visitors drank from the chalybeate spring, believing the iron waters restored health.
examples.zh: 游客们饮用富铁矿泉水，相信含铁泉水能恢复健康。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chalybeate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 填...以防漏, 使不漏水, 装尖铁, 描摹复制
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (variant spelling of caulk) To seal seams against water leaks, or fit sharp spikes to horseshoes.

examples.en: He used waterproof sealant to calk the seams around the wooden window frames.
examples.zh: 他用防水密封胶填塞木窗框周围的接缝以防漏水。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 calk 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: front consisting of the conical head of a missile or rocket that protects the payload from heat during its passage through the atmosphere

examples.en: The architect incorporated a graceful ogive into the cathedral's grand vaulted ceiling design.
examples.zh: 建筑师在大教堂宏伟的拱顶设计中融入了优美的尖顶拱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ogive 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 交叉的, 交叉成X形的
lemmas.def_en: crossed or intersected in the form of an X

examples.en: The botanist carefully examined the decussate leaves arranged in opposite pairs along the stem.
examples.zh: 植物学家仔细检查了沿着茎秆成对交叉生长的叶片。

lemmas.def_en: an intersection or crossing of two tracts in the form of the letter X

family_guide.root_logic: 以 decussate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: expletives used informally as intensifiers

examples.en: Fixing this ancient mechanical clock turned out to be a deuced difficult task.
examples.zh: 修理这个古老的机械钟结果成了一项极其困难的任务。

lemmas.def_en: (used as intensives) extremely

examples.en: she was madly in love
deadly dull

family_guide.root_logic: 以 deuced 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the study of the relative growth of a part of an organism in relation to the growth of the whole

examples.en: The study explores how skeletal allometry influences running speed across various mammal species.
examples.zh: 该研究探讨了骨骼体形变异如何影响各种哺乳动物的奔跑速度。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or marked by allometry

family_guide.root_logic: 以 allometry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 衣着不整的女人, 荡妇
lemmas.def_en: a prostitute who attracts customers by walking the streets

examples.en: The cruel gossip dismissed the overworked maid as nothing more than a lazy slattern.
examples.zh: 残酷的流言蜚语将那位过度劳累的女仆贬低为一个懒散邋遢的女人。

lemmas.def_zh: 不自检点的, 自甘堕落的
lemmas.def_en: characteristic of or befitting a slut or slattern; used especially of women

family_guide.root_logic: 以 slattern 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] To load cargo onto a ship again or forward goods to another destination.

examples.en: The warehouse staff had to reship the returned goods to another regional distribution center.
examples.zh: 仓库工作人员不得不将退回的货物重新转运到另一个区域配送中心。

lemmas.def_zh: 重装, 转载, 重装货物
lemmas.def_en: the act of shipping again (especially by transferring to another ship)

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reship 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 司令官, 将领, 酋长
lemmas.def_en: an important person in India

examples.en: The mountain expedition hired an experienced sirdar to lead the local porter team safely.
examples.zh: 登山队聘请了一位经验丰富的向导首领来安全带领当地搬运工队伍。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sirdar 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to a zygote

examples.en: Early zygotic division is essential for normal embryonic development in all mammalian species.
examples.zh: 早期的合子分裂对所有哺乳动物胚胎的正常发育至关重要。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 zygotic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having the qualities or effects of a poison

examples.en: Industrial factories must not release any harmful toxicant into the local river system.
examples.zh: 工业工厂绝不能向当地河流系统排放任何有害毒物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 toxicant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: n. [用作单]挑圆片(一种游戏)
lemmas.def_en: a game in which players try to flip plastic disks into a cup by pressing them on the side sharply with a larger disk

examples.en: During the rainy afternoon, the children enjoyed playing a lively game of tiddlywinks.
examples.zh: 在那个下雨的下午，孩子们高兴地玩了一场挑圆片游戏。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tiddlywinks 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 很小的, 微不足道的
lemmas.def_en: slightly intoxicated

examples.en: I will take just a tiddly slice of cake because I am full.
examples.zh: 我就吃一小块蛋糕，因为我已经很饱了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tiddly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a heavy textile with a woven design; used for curtains and upholstery

examples.en: The proposed educational reform was officially on the tapis for the council's next meeting.
examples.zh: 拟议中的教育改革正式列入理事会下一次会议的讨论日程。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tapis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （飞机的）横尾翼, 水平安定面
lemmas.def_en: the horizontal airfoil of an aircraft's tail assembly that is fixed and to which the elevator is hinged

examples.en: The technician inspected the aircraft's tailplane to ensure the horizontal stabilizer functioned properly.
examples.zh: 技术人员检查了飞机的横尾翼，以确保水平安定面正常工作。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tailplane 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of various bog plants of the genus Drosera having leaves covered with sticky hairs that trap and digest insects; cosmopolitan in distribution

examples.en: A glistening sundew trapped an unsuspecting fly on its sticky, tentacle-covered leaves.
examples.zh: 一株晶莹的茅膏菜用其布满黏液触毛的叶子困住了一只毫无防备的苍蝇。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sundew 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a material that has been or is capable of being taken up by another substance by either absorption or adsorption

examples.en: The laboratory test measured how effectively the porous carbon material retained the gaseous sorbate.
examples.zh: 实验室测试测量了多孔碳材料截留气体吸着物的有效程度。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sorbate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: with one side forward or to the front

examples.en: The crab moved sideway across the wet sand to escape the approaching ocean wave.
examples.zh: 螃蟹侧向穿过湿沙，以躲避不断逼近的海浪。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sideway 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 弯弯曲曲的, 波状的
lemmas.def_en: curved or curving in and out

examples.en: The river traced a sinuate path through the dense forest toward the distant ocean.
examples.zh: 河流在茂密的森林中蜿蜒流淌，奔向远处的海洋。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sinuate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: accumulation of blood in the pleural cavity (the space between the lungs and the walls of the chest)

examples.en: The trauma surgeon quickly inserted a chest tube to treat the patient's acute hemothorax.
examples.zh: 创伤外科医生迅速插入胸管以治疗患者的急性血胸。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hemothorax 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: in a damnable manner

examples.en: The harsh mountain wind was damnably cold, cutting straight through our heavy winter coats.
examples.zh: 刺骨的山风冷得要命，直接穿透了我们厚重的冬大衣。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 damnably 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: relating to or characteristic of a word whose reference depends on the circumstances of its use

examples.en: Words like here and now carry deictic meaning that depends entirely on conversational context.
examples.zh: 像“这里”和“现在”这样的词带有指示意义，完全依赖于语境。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 deictic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (chiefly North American aviation) When passengers deplane, they get off an airplane.

examples.en: Passengers were asked to remain seated until it was completely safe to deplane.
examples.zh: 乘客被要求保持就座，直到完全安全可以下机为止。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 deplane 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: in an unfortunate or deplorable manner

examples.en: The historic library building was deplorably neglected for decades before restoration work began.
examples.zh: 在修复工作开始之前，这座历史悠久的图书馆建筑被极其令人痛心地忽视了数十年。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 deplorably 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: in a despicable manner

examples.en: He treated his loyal employees despicably before abruptly selling the company.
examples.zh: 在突然卖掉公司之前，他对待忠诚员工的方式极其卑鄙。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 despicably 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: tableware (eating and serving dishes) collectively

examples.en: The ceramic dishware was packed carefully in bubble wrap before the move.
examples.zh: 这套陶瓷餐具在搬家前被小心地用气泡膜包好。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dishware 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 发声困难, 言语障碍
lemmas.def_en: speech disorder attributable to a disorder of phonation

examples.en: Persistent vocal strain caused severe dysphonia, forcing the singer to cancel tours.
examples.zh: 持续的声带劳损导致了严重的发声困难，迫使这位歌手取消巡演。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dysphonia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (of exocrine glands) producing a clear aqueous secretion without releasing part of the secreting cell; important in regulating body temperature

examples.en: Humans possess millions of eccrine glands that help regulate core body temperature.
examples.zh: 人体拥有数百万个外分泌汗腺，有助于调节核心体温。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 eccrine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the sediment that is left after the evaporation of seawater

examples.en: Thick layers of evaporite minerals formed as the ancient inland sea dried up.
examples.zh: 随着古代内海的干涸，形成了厚厚的蒸发岩矿物层。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 evaporite 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: generally any arch shaped structure (but often it refers to the arched roof of an anatomical space)

examples.en: Damage to the fornix can disrupt the transfer of memories to the cortex.
examples.zh: 穹窿受损会扰乱记忆向大脑皮层的传递。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fornix 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: heavy short-tailed oceanic bird of polar regions

examples.en: A lone fulmar glided effortlessly above the choppy waters of the North Atlantic.
examples.zh: 一只管鼻藿在北大西洋波涛汹涌的海面上轻松滑翔。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fulmar 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: primitive predaceous North American fish covered with hard scales and having long jaws with needlelike teeth

examples.en: The angler spotted a garfish swimming near the surface with its needle-like beak.
examples.zh: 钓客注意到一条长着针状长喙的雀鳝在水面附近游弋。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 garfish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a trivalent radical derived from glycerol by removing the three hydroxyl radicals

examples.en: The moisturizing cream contains glyceryl stearate to help keep the skin hydrated.
examples.zh: 这款保湿霜含有硬脂酸甘油酯，有助于保持皮肤水润。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 glyceryl 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a heavy coat worn over clothes in winter

examples.en: He wrapped his heavy wool greatcoat tightly against the biting winter wind.
examples.zh: 他裹紧了厚重的羊毛大衣以抵御刺骨的寒风。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 greatcoat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the smuggling of guns and ammunition into a country secretly and illegally

examples.en: International authorities launched a covert operation to dismantle the cross-border gunrunning ring.
examples.zh: 国际当局展开了一次秘密行动，以摧毁该跨国军火走私团伙。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gunrunning 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (dated) To shout 'halloo' to attract attention or encourage hunting dogs.

examples.en: The lost hikers began to halloo across the canyon, hoping for a rescue response.
examples.zh: 迷路的徒步旅行者开始对着峡谷大声呼喊，希望能得到救援的回应。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 halloo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 握, 抓, 手把, 柄
lemmas.def_en: the appendage to an object that is designed to be held in order to use or move it

examples.en: She lost her handgrip on the wet railing and slipped down the stone stairs.
examples.zh: 她抓湿栏杆的手滑脱了，顺着石阶滑了下去。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 handgrip 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: extant archosaurian reptile

examples.en: Every modern crocodilian species is heavily adapted for a semi-aquatic predatory lifestyle.
examples.zh: 每一种现代鳄目动物都高度适应了半水生的捕食生活方式。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crocodilian 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 宇宙发生的,由宇宙(射)线产生的
lemmas.def_en: pertaining to the branch of astronomy dealing with the origin and history and structure and dynamics of the universe

examples.en: Scientists analyzed cosmogenic isotopes in the meteorite to determine its exposure age.
examples.zh: 科学家分析了陨石中的宇宙成因同位素，以确定其暴露年龄。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cosmogenic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a printer's error; to be corrected

examples.en: The publisher issued a corrigendum to fix the typographical errors in the first edition.
examples.zh: 出版商发布了一份勘误表，以修正第一版中的印刷错误。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 corrigendum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: found along western Atlantic coast

examples.en: Local fishermen managed to catch a barbu near the mouth of the tropical estuary.
examples.zh: 当地渔民在热带河口附近成功捕获了一条弗吉马鲅。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 barbu 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: infected and filled with pus

examples.en: The dentist had to extract the severely abscessed tooth to relieve the intense throbbing pain.
examples.zh: 牙医不得不拔掉那颗严重化脓的病牙，以减轻剧烈的跳痛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 abscessed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the outermost point of the spine of the shoulder blade

examples.en: The athlete suffered a fracture near the acromion after a violent fall onto his shoulder.
examples.zh: 该运动员在肩部猛烈跌地后，肩峰附近发生了骨折。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 acromion 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small bottle that contains a drug (especially a sealed sterile container for injection by needle)

examples.en: The nurse carefully snapped open the glass ampule to draw the sterile medicine into a syringe.
examples.zh: 护士小心地折开玻璃安瓿，将无菌药液抽入注射器中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ampule 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: fishes having large mouths with a wormlike filament attached for luring prey

examples.en: The deep-sea anglerfish uses a glowing lure attached to its head to attract unsuspecting prey.
examples.zh: 深海琵琶鱼利用头上发光的诱饵来吸引毫无防备的猎物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anglerfish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the superior of an abbey of monks

examples.en: The archimandrite welcomed the pilgrims warmly before leading the evening service.
examples.zh: 大僧院长在主持晚祷前热情地迎接了朝圣者。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 archimandrite 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 自造营养物质的, 自给营养的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to organisms (as green plants) that can make complex organic nutritive compounds from simple inorganic sources by photosynthesis

examples.en: Most green plants are autotrophic organisms that produce energy through photosynthesis.
examples.zh: 大多数绿色植物都是通过光合作用制造能量的自养生物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 autotrophic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an impudent or insolent rejoinder

examples.en: Engineers used the dedicated backtalk channel to coordinate during the broadcast.
examples.zh: 工程师们在广播期间使用专用工作联络线路进行协调。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 backtalk 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a grain of barley

examples.en: Historically, the length of an inch was defined as three dry barleycorns.
examples.zh: 在历史上，一英寸的长度曾被定义为三颗干燥的大麦粒。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 barleycorn 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 氏族的, 宗族的, 团结心很强的
lemmas.def_en: characteristic of a clan especially in being unified

examples.en: The remote villagers were notoriously clannish and rarely trusted outsiders at first.
examples.zh: 这个偏远村庄的村民出了名的排外抱团，起初很少信任外人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 clannish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: somewhat large

examples.en: They rented a biggish apartment near the city center for their family.
examples.zh: 他们为了家人在市中心附近租了一套颇大的公寓。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 biggish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 有两唇的, 双唇音的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or being a speech sound that is articulated using both lips

examples.en: Sounds like p and b are classified as bilabial consonants in phonetics.
examples.zh: 在语音学中，像 p 和 b 这样的音被归类为双唇辅音。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bilabial 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a Russian or Polish soup usually containing beet juice as a foundation

examples.en: A warm bowl of borsch served with sour cream is perfect in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天来一碗热气腾腾、搭配酸奶油的罗宋汤再合适不过了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 borsch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: relating to the heel bone or heel

examples.en: The runner took a few weeks off to treat severe calcaneal pain.
examples.zh: 这名跑步运动员休整了几周，以治疗严重的跟骨疼痛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 calcaneal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: tubular pasta filled with meat or cheese

examples.en: She baked homemade cannelloni stuffed with seasoned beef and creamy ricotta cheese.
examples.zh: 她烤制了填满调味牛肉和浓郁乳清干酪的自制肉卷。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cannelloni 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (放咖啡, 茶叶, 烟等的)小罐, 筒, [军](防毒面具的)滤毒罐
lemmas.def_en: metal container for storing dry foods such as tea or flour

examples.en: He kept ground coffee fresh by storing it in an airtight tin cannister.
examples.zh: 他把咖啡粉存放在密封的小铁罐里以保持新鲜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cannister 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the quantity that a car will hold

examples.en: A noisy carful of excited teenagers arrived at the campsite this afternoon.
examples.zh: 今天下午，一整车吵闹而兴奋的年轻人抵达了露营地。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 carful 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a retractable fin keel used on sailboats to prevent drifting to leeward

examples.en: The sailor lowered the centerboard to improve stability against the strong wind.
examples.zh: 水手放下了活动中插板，以提高抗强风时的稳定性。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 centerboard 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a sac or cavity containing fluid especially lymph or cerebrospinal fluid

examples.en: Fluids steadily accumulate inside the cisterna before being distributed across the cell.
examples.zh: 液体在分配到整个细胞之前，先平稳地积聚在脑池中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cisterna 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: coughing up blood from the respiratory tract; usually indicates a severe infection of the bronchi or lungs

examples.en: The doctor ordered an immediate chest scan after the patient reported sudden hemoptysis.
examples.zh: 患者报告突发咯血后，医生立即安排了胸部扫描检查。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hemoptysis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 圆丘, 小丘, 山岗
lemmas.def_en: a small natural hill

examples.en: A solitary wooden bench rested on the grassy hummock overlooking the valley.
examples.zh: 长满杂草的小丘上立着一张孤独的木椅，俯瞰着山谷。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hummock 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 经常, 常常；往往, 在许多场合
lemmas.def_en: more often or more frequently

examples.en: He visits his hometown oftener now that the high-speed train is operating.
examples.zh: 随着高铁的开通，他如今比以往更频繁地回老家。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 oftener 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 假装高人一等的人, 假内行
lemmas.def_en: a person who makes deceitful pretenses

examples.en: Nobody liked listening to that pseud talk endlessly about modern abstract art.
examples.zh: 没人愿意听那个假内行滔滔不绝地谈论现代抽象艺术。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pseud 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: cloth treated on one side with a drying oil or synthetic resin

examples.en: She wiped the colorful oilcloth on the kitchen table after the meal.
examples.zh: 饭后，她把厨房餐桌上那块色彩斑斓的油布擦拭干净。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 oilcloth 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a box containing a collection of cubes or tubes of artists' paint

examples.en: The young artist opened her wooden paintbox and arranged the brushes neatly.
examples.zh: 年轻的画家打开她的木质颜料盒，将画笔整齐地排好。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 paintbox 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a branch of paleontology that deals with the origin and growth and structure of fossil animals and plants as living organisms

examples.en: Her career in paleobiology involves studying the evolution of ancient marine creatures.
examples.zh: 她的古生物学研究工作主要涉及对古代海洋生物演化的探索。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 paleobiology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: tall tufted perennial tropical American grass naturalized as pasture and forage grass in southern United States

examples.en: The golf course was planted with hardy paspalum to resist salty coastal water.
examples.zh: 高尔夫球场种植了耐旱的雀稗，以抵御海滨的含盐水分。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 paspalum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a unit of information equal to 1000 terabytes or 10^15 bytes

examples.en: The cloud storage facility manages more than a petabyte of user data daily.
examples.zh: 该云存储中心每天需要管理超过一千万亿字节的用户数据。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 petabyte 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 凹版印刷, 凹版照相
lemmas.def_en: printing from an intaglio plate prepared by photographic methods

examples.en: The artist chose photogravure to reproduce the delicate textures of his vintage black-and-white portraits.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家选择凹版照相法来复现他黑白老肖像画的细腻质感。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 photogravure 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a sleeveless dress resembling an apron; worn over other clothing

examples.en: The little girl wore a floral pinny over her dress while painting in class.
examples.zh: 小女孩上绘画课时在连衣裙外穿了一件印花围裙。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pinny 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a fleshy fruit (apple or pear or related fruits) having seed chambers and an outer fleshy part

examples.en: Apples and pears belong to the pome family of fruits with seeded cores.
examples.zh: 苹果和梨属于带籽核心的梨果类水果。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pome 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a feeling of evil to come

examples.en: A strange presentiment of danger made her pause before entering the abandoned mansion.
examples.zh: 一种奇怪的危险预感让她在踏入那栋废弃宅邸前停下了脚步。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 presentiment 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 抱怨的, 爱发牢骚的, 易怒的
lemmas.def_en: habitually complaining

examples.en: The exhausted child spoke in a querulous voice after the long delay at the airport.
examples.zh: 在机场漫长的延误之后，筋疲力尽的孩子用抱怨的语气说话。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 querulous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: pejorative terms for an insane asylum

examples.en: He joked that dealing with five unruly puppies turned his home into a nuthouse.
examples.zh: 他开玩笑说，照顾五只不听话的小狗让家里变成了精神病院。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nuthouse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a deceitful and unreliable scoundrel

examples.en: The playful rapscallion stole an apple from the cart and vanished into the crowd.
examples.zh: 那个顽皮的捣蛋鬼从推车上偷了一个苹果，随后消失在人群中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rapscallion 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (British variant spelling of raze) To completely demolish a building or town to the ground.

examples.en: Time and heavy rain could not entirely rase the ancient carvings on the stone.
examples.zh: 时间和暴雨并未能彻底抹去石头上的古老雕刻。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rase 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 延长服役期限, 再从军
lemmas.def_en: a renewed enlistment

examples.en: The experienced sergeant received a generous bonus upon signing his papers for reenlistment.
examples.zh: 那位经验丰富的中士在签署再入伍协议后获得了一笔丰厚的奖金。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reenlistment 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a fabric with prominent rounded crosswise ribs

examples.en: She bought heavy silk repp to reupholster the vintage chairs in her parlor.
examples.zh: 她买了厚重的丝绸棱纹布，用来重新包裹客厅里的复古椅子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 repp 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: erect European annual often grown as a salad crop to be harvested when young and tender

examples.en: A handful of fresh roquette adds a pleasant peppery kick to any summer salad.
examples.zh: 一把新鲜的芝麻菜能给任何夏日沙拉增添宜人的辛辣风味。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 roquette 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (anatomy) a fold or wrinkle or crease

examples.en: The doctor examined the deep ruga visible on the patient's stomach lining.
examples.zh: 医生检查了在患者胃壁上可见的深层皱褶。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ruga 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 产品展销室, 拍卖场
lemmas.def_en: an area where merchandise (such as cars) can be displayed

examples.en: Bidders gathered quietly in the crowded salesroom as the rare diamond appeared.
examples.zh: 当那颗罕见的钻石亮相时，竞拍者在拥挤的拍卖室里悄然聚集。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 salesroom 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 难船救助者, 救难者, 救难船
lemmas.def_en: someone who salvages

examples.en: The skilled salvor secured the sunken cargo before the fierce storm reached the coast.
examples.zh: 在猛烈的风暴抵达海岸之前，老练的打捞员固定好了沉船货物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 salvor 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the pelt or fur (especially the underfur) of a seal

examples.en: The hunter wore a heavy coat lined with sealskin to survive the Arctic winter.
examples.zh: 猎人穿了一件衬有海豹皮的厚大衣，以在北极的严冬中生存。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sealskin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 伊智提哈德；创制；创制和演绎
lemmas.def_en: the endeavor of a Moslem scholar to derive a rule of divine law from the Koran and Hadith without relying on the views of other scholars; by the end of the 10th century theologians decided that debate on such matters would be closed and Muslim theology and law were frozen

examples.en: Modern scholars often rely on ijtihad to address contemporary ethical questions in Islamic law.
examples.zh: 现代学者经常依靠“创制”来解决伊斯兰法中的当代伦理问题。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ijtihad 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (奥斯曼宫廷中的)女奴隶, 婢妾
lemmas.def_en: a woman slave in a harem

examples.en: The museum displays an opulent nineteenth-century painting of a reclining Ottoman odalisque.
examples.zh: 该博物馆展出了一幅十九世纪描绘斜倚奥斯曼女奴的华丽油画。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 odalisque 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 否定论, 否定态度, 抗拒性
lemmas.def_en: characterized by habitual skepticism and a disagreeable tendency to deny or oppose or resist suggestions or commands

examples.en: Constant negativism from team members can quickly destroy morale during a difficult project.
examples.zh: 在困难的项目中，团队成员持续的消极态度会迅速瓦解士气。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 negativism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 照明, 点亮, 启发
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (literary) To light up a place brightly, or bring spiritual and intellectual understanding.

examples.en: A single candle was enough to illumine the dark corners of the basement.
examples.zh: 一支蜡烛就足以照亮地下室昏暗的角落。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 illumine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不能决定的, 不能解决的
lemmas.def_en: not capable of being definitely decided or ascertained

examples.en: The exact age of the sunken wooden vessel remained completely indeterminable to scientists.
examples.zh: 科学家仍完全无法确定这艘沉没木船的具体年代。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 indeterminable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who watches examination candidates to prevent cheating

examples.en: The strict invigilator walked down the quiet aisle to inspect each student's desk.
examples.zh: 严格的监考人员走过安静的过道，检查每名学生的课桌。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 invigilator 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (archaeology / stoneworking) To shape flint or stone into sharp tools by striking off flakes with another stone.

examples.en: The craftsman learned how to knap flint into sharp arrowheads using traditional tools.
examples.zh: 这位手艺人学会了如何使用传统工具敲凿燧石做成锋利的箭头。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 knap 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 轻轻摇曳的, 柔和而光亮的, 巧妙的
lemmas.def_en: softly bright or radiant

examples.en: A lambent glow from the hearth warmed the cozy living room on snowy evenings.
examples.zh: 雪夜里，壁炉微弱柔和的光芒温暖了舒适的客厅。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lambent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any plant of the genus Lithops native to Africa having solitary yellow or white flowers and thick leaves that resemble stones

examples.en: This small pot of lithops looks remarkably like smooth pebbles in the sand.
examples.zh: 这小盆生石花看起来与沙子中光滑的鹅卵石极其相似。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lithops 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: tree of southeastern Asia to Australia grown primarily for its sweet edible fruit resembling litchi nuts; sometimes placed in genera Euphorbia or Nephelium

examples.en: She bought a basket of fresh sweet longan from the local farmers market.
examples.zh: 她从当地农贸市场买了一篮新鲜香甜的龙眼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 longan 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 光滑, 淫荡, 不稳定, 狡猾
lemmas.def_en: feeling morbid sexual desire or a propensity to lewdness

examples.en: The high lubricity of this synthetic oil helps reduce friction between the gears.
examples.zh: 这种合成机油极高的润滑性有助于减少齿轮间的摩擦。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lubricity 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a large muscle that raises the lower jaw and is used in chewing

examples.en: Chewing hard nuts for too long can cause mild strain in the masseter muscle.
examples.zh: 长时间咀嚼硬坚果会导致咬肌轻微拉伤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 masseter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an early style of musket; a slow-burning wick would be lowered into a hole in the breech to ignite the charge

examples.en: The museum displays an authentic seventeenth-century matchlock musket used in coastal defense.
examples.zh: 博物馆里陈列着一支用于海岸防卫的十七世纪原装火绳枪。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 matchlock 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: allowing light to pass through diffusely

examples.en: The artist hung a semitransparent curtain to diffuse the bright afternoon sunlight gently.
examples.zh: 艺术家挂起一道半透明的帘子，以柔和地散射午后明媚的阳光。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 semitransparent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a large sum of money (especially as pay or profit)

examples.en: Winning the tech patent lawsuit earned the small software company megabucks overnight.
examples.zh: 在这场科技专利诉讼中胜诉，让这家小软件公司一夜之间赚了大钱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 megabucks 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 用水池, 水车用贮水池
lemmas.def_en: a pond formed by damming a stream to provide a head of water to turn a mill wheel

examples.en: The surface of the mountain lake was as completely still as a millpond.
examples.zh: 高山湖泊的水面宛如磨坊水池般平静无波。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 millpond 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 婴儿, 娃娃, 女孩
lemmas.def_en: a little girl (usually one you are fond of)

examples.en: The curly-haired moppet giggled happily while chasing pigeons across the public square.
examples.zh: 那个卷发小女孩在广场上追赶鸽子时开心地咯咯直笑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 moppet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a person who lacks good judgment

examples.en: Like a muggins, I agreed to work through the weekend without extra pay.
examples.zh: 我像个傻瓜一样，答应周末无偿加班。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 muggins 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a metric unit of length equal to 10,000 meters

examples.en: The archaic term mym was once proposed to represent ten thousand meters.
examples.zh: 古老单位 mym 曾被提议用来代表一万米长度。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mym 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 肌强直的; 肌紧张的
lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or caused by myotonia

examples.en: Patients with myotonic dystrophy often experience prolonged stiffness and severe muscle weakness.
examples.zh: 肌强直性营养不良患者常伴有持久的僵硬和严重的肌肉无力。

lemmas.def_en: abnormally long muscular contractions; slow relaxation of a muscle after a contraction

examples.en: The genetic disorder causes myotonia, making it difficult for muscles to relax normally.
examples.zh: 这种遗传性疾病会导致肌强直，使肌肉难以正常放松。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 myotonic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a viral disease (usually fatal) of rabbits

examples.en: The regional rabbit population was decimated after the rapid spread of myxomatosis.
examples.zh: 在黏液瘤病迅速蔓延后，该地区的野兔数量锐减。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 myxomatosis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a laborer who is obliged to do menial work

examples.en: His grandfather worked as a sturdy navvy during the construction of the railway.
examples.zh: 他的祖父在修建铁路期间曾是一名强壮的苦工。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 navvy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: not provident; not providing for the future

examples.en: His improvident spending habits soon left him deeply in debt after losing his job.
examples.zh: 他挥霍无度的消费习惯使他在失业后很快陷入巨额债务。

lemmas.def_en: in an improvident manner

examples.en: he lived improvidently for the moment

family_guide.root_logic: 以 improvident 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使失去性功能, 使失去性别特征
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (archaic / literary) To deprive someone of the traditional qualities or powers of their sex.

examples.en: Lady Macbeth prayed to the spirits to unsex her and fill her with cruelty.
examples.zh: 麦克白夫人祈求神灵除去她的女性柔弱，让她充满残酷。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unsex 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 狼似的, 贪得无厌的, 残暴的
lemmas.def_en: resembling or characteristic (or considered characteristic) of a wolf

examples.en: The starved stray dog eyed the raw meat with a fierce, wolfish glare.
examples.zh: 饥饿的流浪狗带着凶狠贪婪的目光盯着那块生肉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wolfish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a minute hairlike projection on mucous membrane

examples.en: Each intestinal villus plays a vital role in absorbing essential nutrients into the bloodstream.
examples.zh: 每根肠绒毛都在将必需营养素吸收进血液中发挥着关键作用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 villus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: very spiny and dense evergreen shrub with fragrant golden-yellow flowers; common throughout western Europe

examples.en: Yellow blossoms covered the thorny whin bushes growing along the windy coastal path.
examples.zh: 沿海风大的小径旁，荆棘密布的荆豆灌木上开满了黄花。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 whin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a matador or one of the supporting team during a bull fight

examples.en: The crowd cheered loudly as the skilled torero gracefully dodged the charging bull.
examples.zh: 当技艺高超的斗牛士优雅地避开冲撞而来的公牛时，人群爆发出热烈的欢呼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 torero 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of various large tropical carnivorous lizards of Africa and Asia and Australia; fabled to warn of crocodiles

examples.en: The expedition team carefully tracked a giant varan moving through the dense tropical swamp.
examples.zh: 探险队小心翼翼地追踪着穿过茂密热带沼泽的一只巨蜥。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 varan 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a bell that is held in the hand

examples.en: The teacher rang a brass handbell to signal the end of morning recess.
examples.zh: 老师摇响铜手摇铃，示意晨间休息结束。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 handbell 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the act of changing into a different form or appearance (especially a fantastic or grotesque one)

examples.en: The novel describes the sudden transmogrification of an ordinary man into an enormous beetle.
examples.zh: 这部小说描述了一个普通人突然变成巨大甲虫的奇异变形。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 transmogrification 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 棕榈的, 多棕榈的, 繁荣的, 从棕榈中提取的
lemmas.def_en: very lively and profitable

examples.en: He often reminisced about the palmy days when his trading business flourished overseas.
examples.zh: 他经常回忆起海外贸易生意蓬勃发展的那段鼎盛岁月。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 palmy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the medical specialty that deals with diseases of the ear, nose and throat

examples.en: She decided to specialize in otorhinolaryngology after completing her general surgical residency.
examples.zh: 在完成普通外科住院医师培训后，她决定专攻耳鼻喉科学。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 otorhinolaryngology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: native grape of southeastern United States; origin of many cultivated varieties

examples.en: Wild muscadine vines grew abundantly along the old wooden fence behind the farm.
examples.zh: 农场后面的旧木栅栏旁长满了野生圆叶葡萄藤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 muscadine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [植] 附子之类(毒草),舟形乌头
lemmas.def_en: a poisonous herb native to northern Europe having hooded blue-purple flowers; the dried leaves and roots yield aconite

examples.en: Gardeners must wear protective gloves when handling poisonous monkshood in the backyard.
examples.zh: 园丁在后院处理有毒的舟形乌头时必须戴上防护手套。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 monkshood 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: large African black-and-white carrion-eating stork; its downy underwing feathers are used to trim garments

examples.en: Villagers often gathered around the respected marabout to seek his spiritual guidance.
examples.zh: 村民们经常聚集在这位受人尊敬的隐士周围寻求精神指引。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 marabout 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: used to make malmsey wine

examples.en: The waiter recommended a chilled glass of sweet Malvasia with our dessert.
examples.zh: 服务员推荐了一杯冰镇甜马尔瓦西亚白葡萄酒来搭配甜点。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 malvasia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 活页式的, 各页可任意装拆的
lemmas.def_en: being or having leaves that can be easily removed or rearranged

examples.en: She organized all her lecture notes neatly inside a sturdy looseleaf binder.
examples.zh: 她把所有的讲义整齐地整理在一个结实的活页夹里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 looseleaf 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 螺旋体, 细螺旋体；[微]钩端螺旋体,细螺旋体
lemmas.def_en: important pathogens causing Weil's disease or canicola fever

examples.en: The lab technician detected pathogenic Leptospira bacteria in the contaminated water sample.
examples.zh: 实验技术员在受污染的水样中检测到了致病性钩端螺旋体。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 leptospira 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 不完善的系统, 不成功的系统, "杰作"
lemmas.def_en: a badly assembled collection of parts hastily assembled to serve some particular purpose (often used to refer to computing systems or software that has been badly put together)

examples.en: This temporary software fix is an ugly kludge that needs immediate rewriting.
examples.zh: 这个临时的软件修复方案是个拙劣的拼凑物，需要立即重写。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kludge 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an esoteric or occult matter resembling the Kabbalah that is traditionally secret

examples.en: The scholar dedicated decades to studying the mystical texts of the Kabala.
examples.zh: 这位学者花了数十年时间研究犹太神秘哲学的秘传文本。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kabala 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the state of being an isomer; the complex of chemical and physical phenomena characteristic of isomers

examples.en: The professor explained how structural isomerism alters the chemical properties of molecules.
examples.zh: 教授解释了结构同分异构现象是如何改变分子化学性质的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 isomerism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: bent into or having an inward curve

examples.en: The rare autumn flower was distinguished by its delicately incurved white petals.
examples.zh: 这种罕见的秋季花卉以其精致内弯的白色花瓣为特征。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 incurved 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: blockage of the intestine (especially the ileum) that prevents the contents of the intestine from passing to the lower bowel

examples.en: Following the complex abdominal surgery, the patient unfortunately developed a paralytic ileus.
examples.zh: 腹部复杂手术后，该患者不幸并发了麻痹性肠梗阻。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ileus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: pick consisting of a steel rod with a sharp point; used for breaking up blocks of ice

examples.en: He chipped away the thick ice block using a sharp steel icepick.
examples.zh: 他用一把锋利的钢制冰锥凿碎了厚厚的冰块。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 icepick 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: in the same place (used when citing a reference)

examples.en: The researcher cited several consecutive quotes from ibidem throughout the academic paper.
examples.zh: 研究人员在整篇学术论文中多次引用了同前引用的文献。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ibidem 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: spore-bearing layer of cells in certain fungi containing asci or basidia

examples.en: Under the microscope, microscopic spores were visibly developing across the fungal hymenium.
examples.zh: 在显微镜下，微小的孢子正沿着真菌的子实层明显生长。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hymenium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: tall coarse plant having thick stems and cluster of white to purple flowers

examples.en: Hikers were warned to avoid giant hogweed because its sap causes burns.
examples.zh: 徒步旅行者被警告避开大豕草，因为其汁液会灼伤皮肤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hogweed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a four-wheeled wagon that runs on tracks in a mine

examples.en: An old electric tramcar rattled steadily down the historic cobblestone street today.
examples.zh: 今天，一辆老式有轨电车在历史悠久的鹅卵石街道上稳稳行驶。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tramcar 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 总钥匙, 万能钥匙, 弹簧锁钥匙
lemmas.def_en: key that secures entrance everywhere

examples.en: The hotel manager used a master passkey to open the locked suite.
examples.zh: 酒店经理用万能钥匙打开了上锁的套房。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 passkey 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 透明的, 澄清的, 明了的
lemmas.def_en: transmitting light; able to be seen through with clarity

examples.en: Tropical fish swam gracefully through the pellucid waters of the shallow bay.
examples.zh: 热带鱼在浅水湾清澈透明的水域中优雅地游动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pellucid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: unlicensed drinking establishment

examples.en: Police officers raided the unlicensed shebeen operating quietly on the town outskirts.
examples.zh: 警官们突击搜查了那家在城镇郊区悄悄营业的非法酒吧。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shebeen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who makes or repairs tinware

examples.en: The skilled tinsmith shaped a custom metal lantern using traditional hand tools.
examples.zh: 熟练的锡匠使用传统手工工具打造了一盏定制金属灯笼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tinsmith 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: employment at home while communicating with the workplace by phone or fax or modem

examples.en: Many tech companies adopted permanent teleworking policies after seeing improved employee productivity.
examples.zh: 许多科技公司在看到员工生产力提高后，采取了永久远程办公政策。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 teleworking 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the customary or habitual hour for the evening meal

examples.en: The children washed their hands and eagerly sat down when suppertime arrived.
examples.zh: 晚饭时间到了，孩子们洗了手，迫不及待地坐了下来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 suppertime 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: reappraisal of a situation or position or outlook

examples.en: The retail store closed early on Sunday afternoon for its annual stocktaking.
examples.zh: 这家零售店在周日下午提前关门进行年度存货盘点。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stocktaking 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [计]= Scanning InfraRed Inspection System,扫描（式）红外检查系统
lemmas.def_en: large spreading Old World tree having large leaves and globose clusters of greenish-yellow flowers and long seed pods that clatter in the wind

examples.en: Engineers calibrated the SIRIS sensor to monitor thermal emissions across the sector.
examples.zh: 工程师校准了红外扫描传感器，以监测整个区域的热辐射。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 siris 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of various compounds of silicon with a more electropositive element or radical

examples.en: The microchip manufacturer applied a thin silicide layer to improve electrical conductivity.
examples.zh: 芯片制造商涂覆了一层薄薄的硅化物以提高导电性能。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 silicide 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: toward one side

examples.en: He glanced sidewise at his partner to see if she noticed the mistake.
examples.zh: 他斜眼看了看搭档，看她是否注意到了这个错误。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sidewise 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: worn or faded from being on display in a store

examples.en: The politician repeated the same shopworn promises that no one believed anymore.
examples.zh: 这位政客重复着那些陈腐的承诺，再也没人相信了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shopworn 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (Islam) a rebellious jinni who leads men astray

examples.en: The elder warned the villagers not to succumb to the whispers of shaytan.
examples.zh: 长者告诫村民们不要屈服于魔鬼的低语。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shaytan 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 做事卤莽的人, 讨厌的人, (行动、方法等的)极端
lemmas.def_en: bounder

examples.en: That little perisher tracked mud all over my freshly cleaned kitchen floor.
examples.zh: 那个讨厌的小家伙把泥巴蹭得我刚擦干净的厨房地板到处都是。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 perisher 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (occult) To attempt to see future events or distant scenes by gazing into a crystal ball, mirror, or water.

examples.en: The fortune teller stared into the black mirror to scry for future events.
examples.zh: 算命师凝视着黑镜，试图占卜未来的事件。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a flighty and disorganized person

examples.en: Don't be such a scatterbrain; make a list before you go shopping.
examples.zh: 别这么丢三落四的，去购物前先列个清单。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scatterbrain 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small sandpiper that breeds in the Arctic and migrates southward along sandy coasts in most of world

examples.en: A lone sanderling scurried along the shoreline, chasing the receding ocean waves.
examples.zh: 一只三趾滨鹬沿着海岸线小跑，追逐着退去的浪花。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sanderling 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To sow grass or crop seeds again on bare or damaged land.

examples.en: We need to reseed the damaged patch of lawn before the spring rains arrive.
examples.zh: 在春雨到来之前，我们需要在受损的草坪上重新播种。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reseed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: inflammation of the kidney and its pelvis caused by bacterial infection

examples.en: The patient was admitted to the hospital with a severe case of acute pyelonephritis.
examples.zh: 该患者因严重的急性肾盂肾炎入院治疗。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pyelonephritis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: preparing for the study of medicine

examples.en: She enrolled in advanced chemistry courses to fulfill her premedical degree requirements.
examples.zh: 她选修了高级化学课程，以满足医学预科的学位要求。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 premedical 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 石柑属；柚叶藤属；黄金葛
lemmas.def_en: any of various tropical lianas of the genus Scindapsus

examples.en: A lush green pothos plant hung gracefully from the sunny living room window.
examples.zh: 一盆郁郁葱葱的绿萝优雅地悬挂在阳光明媚的客厅窗前。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pothos 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: sweet spiced hot milk curdled with ale or beer

examples.en: She drank a warm posset of curdled milk and spiced ale before bed.
examples.zh: 睡前她喝了一杯用凝乳和香料麦芽酒调制的温热牛乳酒。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 posset 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 大缆, 系船索, 曳船索
lemmas.def_en: large heavy rope for nautical use

examples.en: The crew secured the massive cruise ship to the dock with a thick hawser.
examples.zh: 船员们用一根粗大的系船索将巨型邮轮固定在码头上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hawser 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: carcinoma of the liver

examples.en: Doctors discovered a malignant hepatoma during a routine scan of his abdomen.
examples.zh: 医生在对他的腹部进行常规扫描时发现了一个恶性肝细胞瘤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hepatoma 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: wild llama

examples.en: A wild guanaco stood watch on the rocky hillside high in the Andes.
examples.zh: 一只野生原驼伫立在安第斯山脉高处的岩石山坡上放哨。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 guanaco 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 活动的, 骚动的, 起床的
lemmas.def_en: out of bed

examples.en: The entire village was astir early in the morning for the annual harvest festival.
examples.zh: 大清早，整个村庄就为了这一年一度的丰收节而骚动忙碌起来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 astir 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: sessile aquatic animal forming mossy colonies of small polyps each having a curved or circular ridge bearing tentacles; attach to stones or seaweed and reproduce by budding

examples.en: The marine biologist carefully examined a fossilized bryozoan colony under the microscope.
examples.zh: 海洋生物学家在显微镜下仔细观察了一个苔藓虫群落化石。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bryozoan 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: large metal container in which coal or charcoal is burned; warms people who must stay outside for long times

examples.en: They gathered around the glowing charcoal brasier to warm their freezing hands.
examples.zh: 他们围在发光的炭火盆旁，温暖冰冷的双手。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 brasier 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (British informal) To make or repair something clumsily and carelessly.

examples.en: He tried to bodge the leaky pipe with duct tape until the plumber arrived.
examples.zh: 在水管工到来之前，他试图用胶带胡乱修补漏水的水管。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bodge 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: in good time

examples.en: We must awake betimes tomorrow if we want to catch the first morning train.
examples.zh: 如果我们想赶上早班第一趟火车，明天就必须及早起床。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 betimes 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: wood that is steamed until it becomes pliable and then is shaped for use in making furniture

examples.en: She furnished her rustic dining room with an elegant set of antique bentwood chairs.
examples.zh: 她用一套优雅的古董曲木椅布置了她朴素的餐厅。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bentwood 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the status of being born to parents who were not married

examples.en: Centuries ago, the stigma of bastardy often deprived children of their legal inheritance.
examples.zh: 几个世纪前，私生的污名往往会剥夺孩子们的合法继承权。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bastardy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 希伯来文之第十六个字母
lemmas.def_en: the 16th letter of the Hebrew alphabet

examples.en: The student learned to pronounce the guttural sound of the Hebrew letter ayin.
examples.zh: 那个学生学会了希伯来字母 ayin 的喉音发音。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ayin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 分配人, 指定人, 转让者
lemmas.def_en: (law) the party who makes an assignment

examples.en: The contract states that the assignor transfers all intellectual property rights to the company.
examples.zh: 合同规定，转让人将所有知识产权转让给该公司。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 assignor 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: along or following a coast

examples.en: Small fishing vessels usually stick to safe coastwise routes during stormy winter months.
examples.zh: 小型渔船在暴风雨频发的冬季通常沿着安全的沿岸航线行驶。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coastwise 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: noctuid moth larvae that travel in multitudes destroying especially grass and grain

examples.en: Local farmers sprayed their cornfields immediately after discovering an invasive armyworm infestation.
examples.zh: 当地农民在发现粘虫灾害后立即喷洒了玉米地。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 armyworm 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a particle that has the same mass as another particle but has opposite values for its other properties; interaction of a particle and its antiparticle results in annihilation and the production of radiant energy

examples.en: Every known fundamental particle is believed to have a corresponding antiparticle in physics.
examples.zh: 在物理学中，人们认为每个已知的基本粒子都有对应的反粒子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 antiparticle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the dilated portion of a canal or duct especially of the semicircular canals of the ear

examples.en: The priest carefully poured consecrated holy oil from an antique silver ampulla.
examples.zh: 牧师小心翼翼地从一个古董银质圣瓶中倒出祝圣过的圣油。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ampulla 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: fungus used in the preparation of punk for fuses

examples.en: The biologist spotted a bright red fly agaric growing beneath the damp birch trees.
examples.zh: 生物学家在潮湿的桦树下发现了一株鲜红色的毒蝇伞菌。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 agaric 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the process of introducing an acyl group into a compound

examples.en: This organic synthesis step involves the acylation of amines to produce stable amides.
examples.zh: 该有机合成步骤涉及胺的酰化反应以生成稳定的酰胺。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 acylation 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: red pear-shaped tropical fruit with poisonous seeds; flesh is poisonous when unripe or overripe

examples.en: Traditional Jamaican saltfish is usually served alongside freshly cooked, tender yellow ackee.
examples.zh: 传统的牙买加咸鱼通常与新鲜煮熟的嫩黄色西非荔枝果一起食用。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ackee 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of several plants of the genus Achillea native to Europe and having small white flowers in flat-topped flower heads

examples.en: The gardener planted yellow achillea because it survives droughts and attracts beneficial bees.
examples.zh: 园丁种植了黄色欧蓍草，因为它耐旱且能吸引有益的蜜蜂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 achillea 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: dressed in trousers

examples.en: A sharply trousered businesswoman walked briskly toward the conference room for her morning meeting.
examples.zh: 一位穿着利落长裤的女商人快步走向会议室参加早会。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 trousered 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (anatomy) an encircling structure (as the ridge around the base of a tooth)

examples.en: Damage to the brain's cingulum bundle can significantly affect emotional processing and memory.
examples.zh: 大脑扣带束受损会显著影响情绪处理和记忆能力。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cingulum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small flat green bean similar to lima beans

examples.en: She simmered the tender butterbean stew with garlic and fresh herbs for dinner.
examples.zh: 她用大蒜和新鲜香草炖煮了鲜嫩的奶油豆汤作为晚餐。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 butterbean 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: able to or tending to combine

examples.en: Students built a basic combinational logic circuit using several standard digital logic gates.
examples.zh: 学生们使用几个标准数字逻辑门构建了一个基本的组合逻辑电路。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 combinational 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: intended for people with low incomes

examples.en: The company decided to target downscale consumers by offering simpler and cheaper everyday goods.
examples.zh: 该公司决定通过提供更简单、更便宜的日常用品来瞄准低端消费群体。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 downscale 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a rude decoration inscribed on rocks or walls

examples.en: A single ancient graffito carved into the stone wall amused the visiting archaeologists.
examples.zh: 刻在石墙上的一处古代乱画让来访的考古学家们忍俊不禁。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 graffito 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (+ at) (British informal) To stare openly and stupidly at someone or something with your mouth open.

examples.en: Tourists stopped on the busy sidewalk to gawp at the massive movie set.
examples.zh: 游客们停在繁忙的人行道上，呆呆地注视着庞大的电影布景。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gawp 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of medicine that deals with the surgical repair of injuries and wounds arising from accidents

examples.en: Specialists in surgical traumatology rushed to treat victims immediately after the highway crash.
examples.zh: 公路车祸发生后，创伤外科学专家们立即赶去救治伤员。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 traumatology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 趋于时尚的, 风行的, 流行的
lemmas.def_en: intensely fashionable for a short time

examples.en: Sensible investors usually avoid faddish tech trends that lack solid long-term value.
examples.zh: 明智的投资者通常会避开缺乏可靠长期价值的流行科技噱头。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 faddish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: bleeding from the nose

examples.en: Dry winter air often causes sudden epistaxis, but tilting your head forward helps.
examples.zh: 干燥的冬季空气常引起突发性鼻衄，但将头前倾会有所帮助。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 epistaxis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a projection on a bone above a condyle serving for the attachment of muscles and ligaments

examples.en: Repetitive tennis strokes caused severe inflammation near the outer epicondyle of his elbow.
examples.zh: 反复的网球击球动作导致他肘部外上髁附近严重发炎。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 epicondyle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 土气的, 粗俗的,思想简单的,质朴的.带有乡村风味的
lemmas.def_en: characteristic of rural life

examples.en: Despite living in London, he maintained a countrified manner and loved tweed jackets.
examples.zh: 尽管住在伦敦，他仍保持着质朴的乡村风度，且喜爱粗花呢夹克。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 countrified 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a short poem descriptive of rural or pastoral life

examples.en: The poet recited a peaceful classical eclogue describing simple shepherds in rural hills.
examples.zh: 诗人朗诵了一首平静的古典牧歌，描绘了乡村丘陵中淳朴的牧羊人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 eclogue 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the art of wine making

examples.en: She earned a prestigious degree in enology before managing her family's historic vineyard.
examples.zh: 在管理家族历史悠久的葡萄园之前，她获得了著名的葡萄酒酿造学学位。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 enology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: parasitic flatworms having external suckers for attaching to a host

examples.en: Certain freshwater snails act as intermediate hosts for this dangerous parasitic trematode.
examples.zh: 某些淡水螺是这种危险的寄生吸虫的中间宿主。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 trematode 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the nucleus of deuterium; consists of one proton and one neutron; used as a bombarding particle in accelerators

examples.en: Physicists measured the exact binding energy of a deuteron inside the particle accelerator.
examples.zh: 物理学家在粒子加速器中测量了氘核的精确结合能。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 deuteron 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (of a leaf shape) narrowly triangular, wider at the apex and tapering toward the base

examples.en: The botanist carefully identified the plant by its distinctive cuneate leaf shape.
examples.zh: 植物学家通过其独特的楔形叶片仔细辨认了这种植物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cuneate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a thermostat that operates at very low temperatures

examples.en: The superconducting sample was cooled inside a specialized cryostat for several hours.
examples.zh: 超导样品在专用低温恒温器中冷却了数小时。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cryostat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (=crawfish)喇蛄(一种淡水小龙虾),<美>退缩者
lemmas.def_en: tiny lobster-like crustaceans usually boiled briefly

examples.en: The kids spent the sunny afternoon catching crawdads by the shallow riverbank.
examples.zh: 孩子们在浅水河岸边抓淡水小龙虾，度过了一个晴朗的下午。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crawdad 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a hired hand who tends cattle and performs other duties on horseback

examples.en: An experienced cowhand guided the restless herd across the dusty open prairie.
examples.zh: 一名经验丰富的牧牛工带领着躁动的牛群穿过尘土飞扬的开阔草原。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cowhand 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 未慢化的, 未减速的
lemmas.def_en: not made less extreme

examples.en: The core relied on unmoderated neutrons to sustain the rapid chain reaction.
examples.zh: 反应堆堆芯依靠未慢化的中子来维持快速链式反应。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unmoderated 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the study of methods of escaping (especially as a form of entertainment)

examples.en: He practiced escapology for years before successfully freeing himself from the locked safe.
examples.zh: 他练习了多年的脱逃术，才成功从上锁的保险箱中脱身。

lemmas.def_en: an entertainer who is expert in the art of escaping

family_guide.root_logic: 以 escapology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having three unequal crystal axes intersecting at oblique angles

examples.en: The mineral sample crystallized in a complex triclinic system with unequal axes.
examples.zh: 该矿物样品在晶轴不等的复杂三斜晶系中结晶。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 triclinic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: either end of the yard of a square-rigged ship

examples.en: The pirate ship hung a warning lantern high on the starboard yardarm.
examples.zh: 海盗船在右舷桁端高高挂起了一盏警告灯笼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 yardarm 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 如黄蜂的, 腰细的, 易怒的
lemmas.def_en: very irritable

examples.en: Tired and stressed, the manager made several waspish remarks to the staff.
examples.zh: 由于疲倦和压力，经理对员工说了几句尖酸刻薄的话。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 waspish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (pathology) a firm abnormal elevated blemish on the skin; caused by a virus

examples.en: The dermatologist recommended a topical treatment to safely remove the painful verruca.
examples.zh: 皮肤科医生建议使用外用药物安全地去除这个令人疼痛的跖疣。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 verruca 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a stroke normally made in an upward direction

examples.en: Calligraphers apply very light pressure during the swift upstroke of each letter.
examples.zh: 书法家在写每个字母快速向上一笔时只施加很轻的力。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 upstroke 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a powerful small boat designed to pull or push larger ships

examples.en: A sturdy towboat guided the massive cargo barge safely through the narrow canal.
examples.zh: 一艘坚固的拖船引导着庞大的货运驳船安全穿过狭窄的运河。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 towboat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: infection of the vagina

examples.en: The doctor prescribed antibiotics to cure the patient's diagnosed trichomoniasis infection.
examples.zh: 医生开了抗生素来治疗该患者确诊的滴虫病感染。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 trichomoniasis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: <美俚> 催逼的人, 吹毛求疵的人,老找碴的人
lemmas.def_en: (Yiddish) a constant complainer

examples.en: Ignore that chronic kvetch who always finds something wrong with every project.
examples.zh: 别理那个习惯性吹毛求疵的人，他总能在每个项目中挑出毛病。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kvetch 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [冶]下行程(结晶器), [机]下行冲程
lemmas.def_en: a stroke normally made in a downward direction

examples.en: Power was generated efficiently as the engine piston completed its forceful downstroke.
examples.zh: 随着发动机活塞完成强有力的下行冲程，动力被高效地产生。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 downstroke 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 地球人(即地球上的人,该词源于科幻小说)
lemmas.def_en: an inhabitant of the earth

examples.en: The alien ambassador greeted the astonished earthman with a peaceful telepathic message.
examples.zh: 外星使者用平静的心灵感应向这位震惊的地球人致意。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 earthman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a physician who specializes in embryology

examples.en: The embryologist monitored the early cell division under a high-powered digital microscope.
examples.zh: 胚胎学家在高倍数字显微镜下监测早期的细胞分裂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 embryologist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a disease of the intestinal tract

examples.en: Chronic enteropathy often causes severe abdominal pain and poor nutrient absorption.
examples.zh: 慢性肠病常导致严重的腹痛和营养吸收不良。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 enteropathy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (of animals) epidemic among animals of a single kind within a particular region

examples.en: Veterinarians quickly contained the epizootic outbreak before it reached neighboring cattle farms.
examples.zh: 兽医们在动物流行病蔓延至邻近养牛场之前迅速控制了疫情。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 epizootic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [鱼]玉梭鱼(产于大西洋热带区)
lemmas.def_en: large snake mackerel with rings like spectacles around its eyes

examples.en: The restaurant served grilled escolar, which is known for its exceptionally rich flavor.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅供应烤玉梭鱼，这种鱼以味道极其浓郁而闻名。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 escolar 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: rim (or part of the rim) into which spokes are inserted

examples.en: The wheelwright inspected each wooden felly before fitting the heavy iron rim.
examples.zh: 造轮工在装上厚重的铁轮圈前，仔细检查了每一个木质轮缘。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 felly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [法]女流浪儿, 女顽童, 妖冶的女人
lemmas.def_en: a homeless girl who roams the streets

examples.en: With her short haircut and playful charm, she looked like a classic gamine.
examples.zh: 凭借利落的短发和俏皮的魅力，她看起来就像个典型的顽童般俏丽的女孩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gamine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a collection of gimmicks

examples.en: Voters quickly grew tired of the candidate's superficial speeches and political gimmickry.
examples.zh: 选民们很快对该候选人肤浅的演讲和政治伎俩感到厌倦。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gimmickry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the luminous larva or wingless grub-like female of a firefly

examples.en: A tiny glowworm emitted a soft greenish light along the dark forest path.
examples.zh: 一只小萤火虫在黑暗的林间小路上散发着柔和的绿光。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 glowworm 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 鬼鬼祟祟的, 卑躬屈膝的, 低贱的
lemmas.def_en: showing a sense of guilt; ; - Eric Linklater

examples.en: He returned home with a hangdog expression after failing his driving test again.
examples.zh: 驾照考试再次失败后，他带着一副垂头丧气的表情回到了家。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hangdog 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [计] 分级的, 分层的, 层次的
lemmas.def_en: classified according to various criteria into successive levels or layers

examples.en: The military maintains a strictly hierarchic structure to ensure rapid command execution.
examples.zh: 军队保持着严格的分层结构以确保命令的迅速执行。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hierarchic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 最后面的, 最后部的
lemmas.def_en: located farthest to the rear

examples.en: The wolves quickly targeted the hindmost deer lagging behind the fleeing herd.
examples.zh: 狼群迅速锁定了落在逃跑鹿群最后面的那只鹿。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hindmost 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: accumulation of urine in the kidney because of an obstruction in the ureter

examples.en: The ultrasound scan revealed severe hydronephrosis caused by an untreated kidney stone.
examples.zh: 超声波扫描显示，未治疗的肾结石引发了严重的肾盂积水。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hydronephrosis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: in an inflexible manner

examples.en: The headmaster inflexibly refused to bend the school rules for anyone.
examples.zh: 校长固执地拒绝为任何人打破学校的规章制度。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inflexibly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 古时土耳其苏丹的禁卫军; 土耳其兵; 亲信; 爪牙
lemmas.def_en: a loyal supporter

examples.en: Historically, the elite janissary units formed the core of the Ottoman military.
examples.zh: 在历史上，精锐的近卫军部队构成了奥斯曼帝国军队的核心。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 janissary 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (=jihad) 圣战, 维护(或反对)某种信仰的(狂热)运动
lemmas.def_en: a holy war waged by Muslims against infidels

examples.en: The group launched a political jehad against government corruption in the region.
examples.zh: 该团体在该地区发起了一场反对政府腐败的政治抗争。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 jehad 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a young person of either sex

examples.en: He spent the entire afternoon by the canal catching a single tiny tiddler.
examples.zh: 他在运河边坐了整整一下午，只钓到了一条细小的鱼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tiddler 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a musical composition in several movements; has no fixed form

examples.en: The string quartet played an enchanting Mozart divertimento at the garden reception.
examples.zh: 弦乐四重奏在花园酒会上演奏了一首迷人的莫扎特嬉游曲。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 divertimento 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: carnivorous dinosaur of the Permian in North America having a crest or dorsal sail

examples.en: With its distinctive dorsal sail, the Dimetrodon remains a popular prehistoric creature.
examples.zh: 凭借独特的背帆，异齿龙至今仍是一种极受欢迎的史前生物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dimetrodon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [化] 己烯雌酚; 乙┴酚; 二乙基乙烯二苯酚
lemmas.def_en: a potent estrogen used in medicine and in feed for livestock and poultry

examples.en: Doctors previously prescribed diethylstilbestrol to pregnant women before knowing its serious risks.
examples.zh: 在知晓其严重危害之前，医生曾向孕妇开具己烯雌酚。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 diethylstilbestrol 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the part of the skull that encloses the brain

examples.en: The fossil revealed an exceptionally well-preserved braincase belonging to an ancient reptile.
examples.zh: 这块化石展示了一只古代爬行动物保存完好的脑颅骨。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 braincase 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 卑鄙, 落魄, 抛弃, 驱逐
lemmas.def_en: a low or downcast state; - H.L.Menchken

examples.en: Living in utter abjection, the displaced families struggled to find daily bread.
examples.zh: 生活在极度落魄之中，流离失所的家庭艰难地寻求每日温饱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 abjection 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the presence of excessive protein (chiefly albumin but also globulin) in the urine; usually a symptom of kidney disorder

examples.en: Routine urine tests detected mild albuminuria, indicating early-stage diabetic kidney damage.
examples.zh: 常规尿液检查发现了轻微的蛋白尿，表明处于早期糖尿病肾损伤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 albuminuria 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the recipient of an annuity

examples.en: Every month, the retired annuitant receives a steady income from the fund.
examples.zh: 每个月，这位退休的领年金者都会从该基金获得一笔稳定收入。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 annuitant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a bin that holds rubbish until it is collected

examples.en: The heavy steel ashcan rattled as the winter wind swept through the alley.
examples.zh: 冬日的狂风席卷小巷，沉重的铁皮垃圾桶被刮得哐当作响。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ashcan 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: peace of mind

examples.en: Through meditation and philosophical study, the ancient sage attained lasting ataraxia.
examples.zh: 通过冥想和哲学研习，这位古代智者达到了持久的心灵宁静。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ataraxia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: <英>自动提词机(为电视讲话人或演出者逐行映出语句,相当美国英语的Tele Prompter)
lemmas.def_en: a device that displays words for people to read

examples.en: The news anchor read the breaking story smoothly from the scrolling autocue.
examples.zh: 新闻主播顺畅地照着滚动提示机播报了这一突发新闻。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 autocue 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (+ at/from) To flinch, draw back, or turn pale suddenly from fear, pain, or shock.

examples.en: The veteran soldier did not blench even when facing overwhelming enemy fire.
examples.zh: 即便面对铺天盖地的敌方火力，这位老兵也未曾畏缩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 blench 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 女学者, 装做有学问的女人
lemmas.def_en: a woman having literary or intellectual interests

examples.en: In the eighteenth century, she was admired as an intellectual and brilliant bluestocking.
examples.zh: 在18世纪，她因作为一位聪明博学的才女而备受钦佩。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bluestocking 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 汇流排;  汇流条; 母线; 汇刘
lemmas.def_en: an electrical conductor that makes a common connection between several circuits

examples.en: Engineers carefully installed the copper busbar inside the main electrical power panel.
examples.zh: 工程师们小心翼翼地将铜母线安装在主配电盘内部。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 busbar 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: abnormal loss of mineral salts (especially from bone)

examples.en: Poor diet and acid erosion can cause progressive demineralization of tooth enamel.
examples.zh: 不良饮食和酸蚀会导致牙齿牙釉质的渐进性脱矿。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 demineralization 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [植]头状花序, 聚生花,小头,骨端
lemmas.def_en: a dense cluster of flowers or foliage

examples.en: The sunflower exhibits a massive capitulum composed of hundreds of tiny florets.
examples.zh: 向日葵呈现出由数百朵细小管状花组成的巨大头状花序。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 capitulum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (外有木箱保护的)小口大玻璃瓶
lemmas.def_en: a large bottle for holding corrosive liquids; usually cushioned in a special container

examples.en: Workers carefully moved the large carboy of corrosive acid to the chemical storage room.
examples.zh: 工人们小心翼翼地把装有腐蚀性酸液的大玻璃瓶搬到化学品储藏室。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 carboy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: candlewood of Mexico and southwestern California having tall columnar stems and bearing honey-scented creamy yellow flowers

examples.en: The bizarre cirio tree resembles a massive upside-down carrot growing in the desert.
examples.zh: 奇特的烛木长在沙漠里，外形就像一根巨大的倒立胡萝卜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cirio 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having the power of implying or suggesting something in addition to what is explicit

examples.en: Poets often use words with rich connotative meanings to evoke deep emotional responses.
examples.zh: 诗人经常使用内涵丰富的词汇来唤起深刻的情感共鸣。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 connotative 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a government building where customs are collected and where ships are cleared to enter or leave the country

examples.en: The old stone customhouse by the historic harbor now operates as a maritime museum.
examples.zh: 历史悠久的港口旁那座旧石头海关大楼，现在作为海事博物馆运营。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 customhouse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (architecture) a molding for a cornice; in profile it is shaped like an S (partly concave and partly convex)

examples.en: The architect incorporated a delicate cyma molding to smooth the transition between walls.
examples.zh: 建筑师融入了精致的反曲线线脚，以使墙面之间的过渡更柔和。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cyma 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of numerous perennials having tuberous roots and long narrow bladelike leaves and usually yellow lily-like flowers that bloom for only a day

examples.en: Bright orange daylily blooms opened this morning along the border of our garden.
examples.zh: 今天清晨，花园边界绽放出一朵朵亮橙色的萱草花。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 daylily 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: removal of the amino radical from an amino acid or other amino compound

examples.en: The liver uses deamination to convert excess amino acids into ammonia and keto acids.
examples.zh: 肝脏利用脱氨基作用将多余的氨基酸转化为氨和酮酸。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 deamination 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a cathode-ray tube in a television receiver; translates the received signal into a picture on a luminescent screen

examples.en: Early television broadcasts were preserved for posterity on grainy kinescope film recordings.
examples.zh: 早期的电视广播是作为颗粒感明显的显像管胶片记录留存给后人的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kinescope 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (dialect / archaic) To teach someone a hard lesson or beat them.

examples.en: That tough experience will larn him not to trust every stranger he meets.
examples.zh: 那次惨痛的经历会让他记住，别轻信遇到的每一个陌生人。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 larn 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 半加仑, 半加仑的酒
lemmas.def_en: a pot that holds 2 quarts

examples.en: The villagers presented him with a fresh pottle of sweet wine after harvest.
examples.zh: 丰收之后，村民们送给他半加仑新鲜的甜葡萄酒。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pottle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: designated paved area beside a main road where cars can stop temporarily
